fi-hanke-08579e34.s: The government of Prime Minister Orpo negotiated a public finance plan from 22 to 23 April 2025 and, according to the minutes, the legislation on general compensation for celiac by the end of 2026 is being prepared. The government has already implemented a legislative amendment which has allowed additional food expenditure on celiac disease to be taken into account as part of the Act on Social Protection (1412/1997).
fi-hanke-08579e34.t: Act amending the Disability Benefits Act

fi-hanke-08759a35.f: Government proposal to amend section 60 of the Environmental Protection Act
fi-hanke-08759a35.s: According to the entry into force of the Law on the Protection of the Environment, the Directive is amended to calculate and present the security of the waste treatment business at VAT-free prices, which would amend section 60 of the YSL and lay down provisions for the entry into force of the Law, both for current and future environmental permit decisions.
fi-hanke-08759a35.t: Act amending section 60 of the Environmental Protection Act

fi-hanke-0887f380.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law (mapping and information on non-vaccinated) on the temporary modification of the infectious disease law
fi-hanke-0887f380.s: The proposal proposes a temporary amendment of the infectious disease law to allow the municipality's infectious disease authority to contact non-vaccinated persons in order to inform them of the benefits and procedures of taking Covid 19, based on information from the municipality's own patient register or the Health and Welfare Institute.
fi-hanke-0887f380.t: Temporary amendment of the infectious disease law (mapping and information of non-vaccinated)

fi-hanke-08b85435.s: The project will assess ways to improve the efficiency of the criminal process and speed up the handling of criminal cases and the need for changes to the preliminary investigation law, preparing proposals for legislative changes and also making other proposals for the handling of criminal cases in order to develop police, prosecution and judicial practices and procedures.
fi-hanke-08b85435.t: Project assessing the effectiveness of the criminal process and the need for changes to the Act on Pre-Investigation

fi-hanke-0916e325.s: The project will transform the existing Waste Act (646/2011) into a circular economy law based on the report of the Circular Economic Law Working Group (10.2.2026), also taking into account the implementation of EU regulation.

fi-hanke-0a051409.s: The aim is to prepare a proposal for a revision of the rules on compensation for loss of liberty for the innocent or convicted person by establishing a ceiling on compensation.
fi-hanke-0a051409.t: Modernisation of the provisions on compensation to be paid to innocent persons or sentenced persons

fi-hanke-0b8f3fe2.s: The project will prepare the provisions necessary for the implementation of the ADR on consumer disputes (EU) 2025/2647) and will identify other legislative changes needed to improve the functioning of the Consumer Dispute Board and prepare the necessary proposals for them.
fi-hanke-0b8f3fe2.t: Review of the regulation on alternative dispute resolution for consumer disputes

fi-hanke-0d364501.s: In the third phase of the project, Chapter 5a of the Police Act would be amended as necessary to extend the powers of intelligence to the permanent residence.
fi-hanke-0d364501.t: Legislative project State and intelligence for permanent housing phase 3

fi-hanke-0db09ba8.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Maldives
fi-hanke-0db09ba8.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the exercise of their traffic.
fi-hanke-0db09ba8.t: With a view to approving and implementing the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Maldives

fi-hanke-11031ed9.s: The government is implementing a voluntary return and exit package, which includes, among other things, the abolition of the right of illegal residents to non-urgent social and health services and social security, in other words, the return to the legal situation prior to the last parliamentary term.
fi-hanke-11031ed9.t: Preparation of the regulation of health rights for people in Finland who are in breach of immigration law

fi-hanke-1159580f.f: Government proposal to implement the amendment of the Air Quality Directive
fi-hanke-1159580f.s: Implementation of the amendment to Directive (EU) 2024/2881 of the European Parliament and of the Council on ambient air quality and improvement of air quality (2008 / 50 / EC) by amending the Environmental Protection Act and the Air Quality Regulation. The deadline for national implementation expires on 10 December 2026.
fi-hanke-1159580f.t: on the implementation of the amendment of the Air Quality Directive

fi-hanke-1327df52.s: The project aims to implement the amendments made in 2024 by Directive (EU) 2024/3101 of the EU Directive on ship emissions, while proposing certain amendments to the Annex to the International Convention on the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL).
fi-hanke-1327df52.t: Amendments to the Marine Environmental Protection Act; implementation of the Ship Emissions Directive

fi-hanke-1348c2b2.s: The proposal for a directive is intended to allow for a reduction in taxation on the basis of equity financing, thus bringing its tax treatment closer to debt financing, in order to reduce the need for companies to finance their growth, due to taxation, precisely through foreign capital.
fi-hanke-1348c2b2.t: Proposal for a Council Directive on the reduction in corporate taxation on the basis of debt and equity and on the limitation of the deductibility of interest

fi-hanke-136aac4c.s: In accordance with Prime Minister Orpo's government programme (2023), the government is reforming the legislation on basic art education, with the aim of improving the accessibility of teaching, taking into account different areas of art.
fi-hanke-136aac4c.t: Modernisation of the legislation on basic art education

fi-hanke-13a31241.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Food Act

fi-hanke-167bbf62.s: The project will prepare the national legislative changes necessary for the entry into force of the EU Return Regulation.
fi-hanke-167bbf62.t: Legislative project on the entry into force of the EU Return Regulation

fi-hanke-1774373a.f: Government proposal to change the law on outdoor activities
fi-hanke-1774373a.s: The project is intended to update the Outdoor Outdoor Law in line with the Constitution and to make some technical changes to the Code's procedural provisions, taking into account the protection of property. The law will be updated using the 2015 Outdoor Outdoor Act Assessment Survey.
fi-hanke-1774373a.t: Act on the amendment of the Law on Outdoor Awards

fi-hanke-17be9bb9.s: The Ministry of Defence has set up a task force to identify regulatory needs for military explosives and to prepare the necessary regulations.
fi-hanke-17be9bb9.t: Preparation of legislation on military explosives

fi-hanke-18674e20.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on property tax valuation reform
fi-hanke-18674e20.s: The need to reform the valuation criteria for real estate is driven by the already known and more detailed problems highlighted in various studies in relation to the largely outdated valuation criteria currently in place.
fi-hanke-18674e20.t: Legislative framework for the reform of property tax valuation

fi-hanke-1a1ed2f5.f: Government proposal for a support mechanism for fossil-free flexibility (Winter Energy Support)
fi-hanke-1a1ed2f5.s: The government's proposal promotes the construction and entry into the market of flexible capacity for long-term electricity. The aim is to support the balance of the electricity system in a context where renewable energy is increasing its share of electricity production.
fi-hanke-1a1ed2f5.t: on a mechanism to support fossil-free flexibility (Winter Energy Support)

fi-hanke-1cc5241e.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend Articles 5 (l) of the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Renewable Fuels in Transport and sections 5 and 7 of the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Biofuels
fi-hanke-1cc5241e.s: - the proposal to amend the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Renewable Fuels in Transport and the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Biofuels, which aims to increase flexibility in meeting the distribution obligations, in the context of the package of measures decided by Prime Minister Petteri Orpo;
fi-hanke-1cc5241e.t: amending Articles 5 (l) and 7 of the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Renewable Fuels in Transport and the Act on the Promotion of the Use of Biofuels

fi-hanke-1dc102ea.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on the use of an automatic vehicle on the road and related laws (Adoption of amendments to the Road Transport Convention and preparation of the necessary national regulations)
fi-hanke-1dc102ea.s: Preparation of the adoption of the amendments to the Convention on road transport and national regulation.
fi-hanke-1dc102ea.t: Act on the use of an automatic vehicle on the road and related laws (adoption of amendments to the Road Transport Convention and preparation of the necessary national regulations)

fi-hanke-1e4bb48c.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the Compensation of the Foreign Service
fi-hanke-1e4bb48c.s: The project is preparing the necessary amendments to the Foreign Service Compensation Act (596/2006) to improve the system of reimbursement, such as the payment of day care allowances during leave on the place of employment and the reform of the provisions on short-term missions in order to support reconciliation between family life and work.
fi-hanke-1e4bb48c.t: amending the Act on the Compensation of Foreign Service

fi-hanke-1e7cf532.s: The project will assess the needs for the development of legislation on the decommissioning of land-based power plants and draft legislative proposals for the implementation of the relevant government programme record.
fi-hanke-1e7cf532.t: Legislative project on decommissioning and restoration obligations for disused land-wind power plants

fi-hanke-1fa80265.s: The Ministry of Transport and Communications has prepared an evaluation report on the need for changes to the fairway laws. The fairways are defined as the Railway Act (110/2007) and the Transport System and Road Act (503/2005).
fi-hanke-1fa80265.t: Assessment memo on the need for change of fairway laws

fi-hanke-2001de14.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on support for server centres in 2026-2036 and related laws
fi-hanke-2001de14.s: The government decided in budget line 2026 that no proposal would be submitted.
fi-hanke-2001de14.t: Law on support for server centres in 2026-2036 and related laws

fi-hanke-22306ff5.f: Government proposal to regulate retail prices during the electricity price crisis
fi-hanke-22306ff5.s: A law allowing retail prices for electricity to be regulated during the electricity price crisis would be laid down in a separate law, the possible entry into force and validity of the law, and the inclusion of the compensation required for price regulation in the State budget would be decided upon in the context of the adoption of the Act of Enforcement.
fi-hanke-22306ff5.t: Law on the regulation of retail prices during the electricity price crisis

fi-hanke-239dd23a.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on Space and the Act on Land Status and Certain Studies
fi-hanke-239dd23a.s: The aim of the proposal is to promote the conditions of operation of the space industry by focusing on supervision and licensing, and by harmonising and clarifying authorisation procedures and certain conditions for granting permits.
fi-hanke-239dd23a.t: Amendment of the Law on Space Activities and the Law on Land stations and Certain Studies

fi-hanke-246759d6.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 93 of the Income Tax Act
fi-hanke-246759d6.t: Act amending section 93 of the Income Tax Act

fi-hanke-269726f8.s: The project aims to identify ways of preventing so-called "undue complaints' and" serial complaints' in administrative courts.
fi-hanke-269726f8.t: Prevention of undue complaints and serial complaints in the use of government loans

fi-hanke-26c7fdab.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of legislation on the completion of qualifications in the form of open university education
fi-hanke-26c7fdab.s: It proposes to amend the University Act and the Polytechnic Act so that university degrees can also be carried out in the form of open university education, which is intended to be submitted to the Parliament of Finland during the current parliamentary term.
fi-hanke-26c7fdab.t: Legislation on the performance of qualifications in the form of open university education

fi-hanke-270bbba7.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland supplementing the Government's proposal amending section 21 of the Tax Procedure Act (HE 141/2025 vp)
fi-hanke-270bbba7.s: The proposal complements the Government's proposal to amend section 21 of the Tax Procedure in the light of the comments made in the opinion of the Committee on Constitutional Affairs, PeVL 48/2025.
fi-hanke-270bbba7.t: supplementing the Government's proposal to amend section 21 of the Tax Code (HE 141/2025 vp)

fi-hanke-274537fe.f: Government bill amending the National Gallery Act
fi-hanke-274537fe.s: Partial renewal of the Act on the National Gallery, which examines, for example, the status of the State Commission of Art and the delegation to the National Gallery.
fi-hanke-274537fe.t: Act amending the Act on the National Gallery

fi-hanke-291a4bf8.s: The purpose of the legislative work project is to prepare legislative changes related to the implementation of the EU Regulation on speeding up the authorisation of defence capability projects, which is linked to the fifth Omnibus package on defence.
fi-hanke-291a4bf8.t: Implementation of the EU Regulation on speeding up the authorisation procedure for defence preparedness projects

fi-hanke-298690b8.s: The project provides for a permanent deferral of the fairway charge from 1.1.2025, which has been suspended and updated.
fi-hanke-298690b8.t: Amendment of the Fairway Charges Act to halve the fairway charge permanently

fi-hanke-2ab0ee3d.s: The project explains the scope of the fine and fine law (754/2010), as well as other needs for amendment of the law.
fi-hanke-2ab0ee3d.t: Overall review of the fine procedure (streamlining the criminal process) (Phase II)

fi-hanke-2b865bf9.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 21 of the Welfare Act
fi-hanke-2b865bf9.t: Amendment of section 21 of the Welfare Act

fi-hanke-2bc7c6ef.f: Government proposal to amend sections 1 and 2 of the Law on State Financing for National Arts and sections 5 and 6 of the Act on the Promotion of Performing Arts
fi-hanke-2bc7c6ef.s: Svenska teatern would be transferred from the State share of performing art to the statutory funding of national art works.
fi-hanke-2bc7c6ef.t: amending sections 1 and 2 of the Law on State Financing for National Arts and sections 5 and 6 of the Act on the Promotion of Performing Arts

fi-hanke-316120ce.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care
fi-hanke-316120ce.s: The project will develop regulation on the processing of social and health care customer information so that it is more easily accessible, especially between social and health care, as well as between welfare areas and other authorities.
fi-hanke-316120ce.t: Act amending the Act on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care

fi-hanke-326a1527.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation to change the VAT rate for sweets and chocolate
fi-hanke-326a1527.s: The proposal proposes to amend the VAT rate applicable to sweets and chocolate as agreed in the spring 2024 budgetary plan, which proposes to increase the rate for sweets and chocolate from 14% to 25.5%, which is planned to enter into force on 1 June 2025.
fi-hanke-326a1527.t: Legislation on the conversion of the VAT rate on sweets and chocolate

fi-hanke-33136a1c.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Tax Procedure Act and certain other laws
fi-hanke-33136a1c.t: amending the Tax Procedure Act and certain other laws

fi-hanke-346702e6.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Working Time Act and certain other laws
fi-hanke-346702e6.s: On 16 April 2026, the Committee of Ministers set out the possibility of strengthening the system of penalties for non-compliance with working time and annual leave documents.
fi-hanke-346702e6.t: Amendment of the Working Time Act and certain other laws

fi-hanke-3904e482.t: Project to amend the Alcohol Act (abolition of marketing restrictions for Finnish operators)

fi-hanke-3c6af46a.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Food Act, the Feed Act and the Animal Disease Act
fi-hanke-3c6af46a.s: The main objective of the amendment is to increase the powers required by the Food and Feed Act to deal with situations of disruption of normal conditions, and to introduce further individual amendments and corrections to the legislation, and to introduce a regulatory mandate for cooperation on zoonoses between public authorities.
fi-hanke-3c6af46a.t: amending the Food Act, the Feed Act and the Animal Disease Act

fi-hanke-3d4fe421.s: The revision of the law on the Sami courts is still necessary, partly outdated, and problems have been identified as regards the functioning of the law.
fi-hanke-3d4fe421.t: Commission preparing for the amendment of the Sami District Act

fi-hanke-3d5070cc.s: The project assesses the development needs of the Safety Clearing Act (726/2014) and provides an evaluation memo.

fi-hanke-3dd7a60d.s: The project will prepare proposals for the national implementation of EU Regulation (EU) 2025/2365 on plastic pellets, which entered into force on 16 December 2025 and will apply on 17 December 2027 (excluding shipping for which the Regulation will apply on 17 December 2028).
fi-hanke-3dd7a60d.t: Implementation of the EU plastic pellet Regulation

fi-hanke-408d871c.s: The project will assess whether there is a need to amend legislation on archaeological heritage.
fi-hanke-408d871c.t: Reform of legislation on archaeological heritage

fi-hanke-40b29d9f.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on criminal intelligence of the Border Guard, thereby improving the ability of the Border Guard to better inform the Border Guard about internal security threats associated with the tasks of the Border Guard.
fi-hanke-40b29d9f.t: Legislative project on border guard criminal intelligence legislation (Phase 2)

fi-hanke-41afd1d5.s: The legislative project explains the needs for change in the Act and prepares the proposal for a new Act of the Municipality of Finland and any other legislative amendments that may be required. The preparatory work has been carried out in the Steering Group and the Legislative Preparation Group from 13.10.2021 to 31.3.2023. The draft law was in the consultation round from 28.8.to 20.10.2023 and is now in further preparation.
fi-hanke-41afd1d5.t: Total reform of the Act on the Municipality of Killers

fi-hanke-42401c10.f: Government proposal amending the Law on the Resolution of Credit Institutions and Investment firms and certain other laws
fi-hanke-42401c10.s: The project will prepare the necessary amendments to national legislation due to the implementation of the CRD Amendment Directive of 30 March 2026 (BRRD3), the DGS2 Directive and the SRMR2 amendment regulation.
fi-hanke-42401c10.t: amending the Law on the Resolution of Credit Institutions and Investment firms and certain other laws

fi-hanke-43e0520d.s: The overall reform of the Åland self-government law is being prepared in several government periods. The law would replace the 1991 self-government law and would be the fourth self-government law in order to update the Åland self-government law and create the conditions for the development of self-government in a more flexible way.
fi-hanke-43e0520d.t: Overall reform of the Åland Act on Self-Government

fi-hanke-452697b5.s: The aim of the project is to prepare legislative changes concerning the processing of personal data and the rights of access to information in the rescue operation. The Board of Directors' proposal is to be submitted to the Parliament of Finland during the autumn session of 2026 and the legislative changes are to enter into force in 2027.
fi-hanke-452697b5.t: Legislative project on the processing of personal data and access rights of the rescue operation

fi-hanke-4561553d.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of the Agreement on Mutual Assistance and Cooperation in Customs Matters with the Republic of Moldova
fi-hanke-4561553d.s: Customs cooperation agreement with Moldova to combat customs offences.
fi-hanke-4561553d.t: With a view to adopting and implementing the Agreement on Mutual Assistance and Cooperation in Customs Matters with the Republic of Moldova

fi-hanke-45c8220c.f: Government proposal for a law on the management of waste in incidents
fi-hanke-45c8220c.s: The proposal proposes a new law on the management of waste in emergency situations, and a review will be carried out of the changes to other environmental legislation, with the aim of laying down provisions on the powers and responsibilities of the authorities in the event of a waste management disruption, excluding urban waste management incidents.

fi-hanke-46099b1c.f: Government proposal on the reform of the university study service
fi-hanke-46099b1c.s: The proposal proposes to reform the regulation of the national information reserves of the universities of Chapter 5 of the National Register of Studies and Qualifications (884/2017).
fi-hanke-46099b1c.t: on the reform of the university study centre

fi-hanke-49cacc5e.s: The corporate responsibility directive aims to promote the sustainable and responsible functioning of businesses, and the new provisions ensure that businesses recognise and address the harmful human rights and environmental impacts of their activities.
fi-hanke-49cacc5e.t: National implementation of the Corporate Responsibility Directive

fi-hanke-49ef2d6a.s: The aim of the directive is to establish a comprehensive framework for the effective prevention and fight against violence against women and domestic violence throughout the Union, including criminal law, victim rights and support, and prevention and cooperation between the various actors.
fi-hanke-49ef2d6a.t: Implementation of the Directive on combating violence against women and domestic violence (NKV Directive)

fi-hanke-4b8a9481.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 4 of the Act on the restriction of the use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment
fi-hanke-4b8a9481.s: The proposal proposes to amend section 4 of the RoHS Act (387/2013) in order to implement the OSOA Directive (EU 2025/2456) and to move to the reference procedure in order to ensure that certain technical annexes and amendments to the RoHS Directive (EU 2011 / 65) enter into force directly without national action.
fi-hanke-4b8a9481.t: amending section 4 of the Act on the restriction of the use of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment

fi-hanke-4bd5d90d.f: Government proposal on investment loans granted to developing countries to the Parliament of Finland
fi-hanke-4bd5d90d.s: The proposal proposes to introduce a new law on subsidised investment loans to developing countries and to repeal the existing law on interest rate subsidies to developing countries (114/2000) with a view to modernising the regulatory environment.
fi-hanke-4bd5d90d.t: on subsidised investment loans to developing countries

fi-hanke-4bd687c0.f: Government proposal for the adoption and entry into force of the family and spouse agreement between Finland and Australia
fi-hanke-4bd687c0.s: The government proposal for the agreement is due to be submitted in autumn 2026.
fi-hanke-4bd687c0.t: Adoption and entry into force of the family and spouse agreement between Finland and Australia

fi-hanke-4dc05ee9.s: In the first instance, the Digital Public Communications Legislative Group has set up a sub-group on e-Service for Justice to assess the regulation of the service sector in the Ministry of Justice, with a view to significantly increasing the use of electronic means of communication and reducing paper mail in the field of justice.

fi-hanke-4e504d51.s: The purpose of the project is to transpose the amendment of the Waste Framework Directive into Finnish law, with the objectives and actions of reducing food waste and the responsibility of textile producers.
fi-hanke-4e504d51.t: Legislative project to implement the EU Waste Framework Directive (food and textile waste)

fi-hanke-4ed14604.s: The project prepares the provisions for the implementation of the entry on strengthening competition neutrality in Prime Minister Orpo's government programme, which will be carried out in official work and will be based on the evaluation report of the recommendations of Professor Kirsi-Maria Halonen's report and the resulting feedback.

fi-hanke-504b388d.s: According to the registration of Petteri Orpo's government programme (p. 195), the government will investigate the extension of the limitation period for sexual offences against children or the waiver of the limitation of the right to blame and will take the necessary measures.
fi-hanke-504b388d.t: Evaluation of limitation periods for the right to prosecute sexual offences against children

fi-hanke-519c110e.f: Draft legislation on the renewal of the employment condition of the employee to the Parliament of Finland of the Board of Directors
fi-hanke-519c110e.s: The Board of Directors decided on 11 February 2022 to renew the employment condition required for unemployment benefit, so that the employment condition would be determined by the monthly income limit condition (EUR 844 in 2021), and the employment condition could also be generated in periods of 0.5 months.
fi-hanke-519c110e.t: Legislation to reform the employment condition of the employee

fi-hanke-524f1256.f: Government proposal amending section 20 of the Law on Privileges and Immunities for International Conferences and Special Representatives
fi-hanke-524f1256.s: The Government's proposal amends section 20 of the Act on Privileges and Immunities of International Conferences and Special Representatives (572/1973). The legislative mandate in place is from the old form of government and will be updated to meet the current requirements of punctuality and precision.
fi-hanke-524f1256.t: amending section 20 of the Act on Privileges and Immunities for International Conferences and Special Representatives

fi-hanke-53487b2b.s: In April 2026, the Ministry of Finance published an assessment of the conditions for the implementation of the regional tourist tax. The draft draft framework law allowing regional tourist tax was in the consultation round in the summer of 2026.

fi-hanke-5379c6fb.s: Prepare legislation to ban integrity treatments.

fi-hanke-55b45cc8.f: Government proposal for reform of the Common Fisheries Policy control legislation
fi-hanke-55b45cc8.s: The draft law would implement Regulation (EU) 2023/2842 of the European Parliament and of the Council, which amended the control system of the Common Fisheries Policy, and would also make any other legislative changes that had been felt necessary.
fi-hanke-55b45cc8.t: Reform of the Common Fisheries Policy control legislation

fi-hanke-58b24f67.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the copyright law
fi-hanke-58b24f67.s: A government proposal is being prepared to meet the national requirements of copyright law regarding the licensing of contracts and the enforcement of rights.

fi-hanke-5baba28b.f: Government bill amending section 2 of the Environmental Damage Fund Act
fi-hanke-5baba28b.s: The Environmental Damage Fund Act (1262/2022) provides for a technical limitation of damage covered by the HNS Convention, thus preventing duplication of regulation.
fi-hanke-5baba28b.t: Amendment of section 2 of the Environmental Damage Fund Act

fi-hanke-5bcb0fbf.f: Government proposal for a law on the conditions for the affiliated position of Fintraffic Oy
fi-hanke-5bcb0fbf.s: The project would lay down the conditions for the participation of the Finnish Transport Control Company Fintraffic Oy in relation to the State authorities and other state actors and would provide for a uniform 20% exit limit for all Fintraffic Group companies under the EU Procurement Directive.
fi-hanke-5bcb0fbf.t: Act on the conditions for the affiliated position of the limited liability company Fintraffic Oy

fi-hanke-5ee944b3.s: The project amends the Act on the Energy Certificate Information System for Buildings in order to comply with the requirements of the recast Directive on the Energy Efficiency of Buildings (2024/1275 / EU, hereinafter referred to as the Directive).
fi-hanke-5ee944b3.t: Amendment of the Act on the Energy Certificate System for Buildings (EPBD 2024)

fi-hanke-5fcf7ee3.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for national legislation supplementing the EU Veterinary Medicinal Regulation
fi-hanke-5fcf7ee3.s: The proposal would provide for national regulation to supplement the EU Veterinary Medicinal Regulation in so far as it concerns the administration of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health.
fi-hanke-5fcf7ee3.t: National legislation supplementing the EU Regulation on veterinary medicinal products

fi-hanke-612921d7.s: The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health has set up a working group to reform the legislation on the functioning and financing of the Institute of Health and Safety at Work, which is partly outdated and incomplete, and which must take into account, among other things, the requirements of the State Aid Act and EU State Aid Regulation.
fi-hanke-612921d7.t: Modernisation of legislation on the functioning and financing of the Institute for Health at Work

fi-hanke-616ee3e9.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation to amend the SORA provisions
fi-hanke-616ee3e9.s: The aim of the proposal is to clarify the provisions on the withdrawal of the right to study and drug testing of the Vocational Education and Training Act, the University Act and the Polytechnic Law, based on the development needs identified in the final report of the Socrates project, as set out by the Ministry of Education and Culture.
fi-hanke-616ee3e9.t: Legislative changes to the provisions of the Sora

fi-hanke-62c9df54.f: Government proposal to temporarily ban imports of natural gas and liquefied natural gas from the Russian Federation and White Russia
fi-hanke-62c9df54.s: HE is a law on the temporary prohibition of the import of natural gas and liquefied natural gas from the Russian Federation and the White Russia following the Russian military attack on Ukraine and to ensure the security of energy in Finland.
fi-hanke-62c9df54.t: Act temporarily prohibiting the import of natural gas and liquefied natural gas from the Russian Federation and White Russia

fi-hanke-636603be.s: OM / KRO / RPY In accordance with Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme, the possibilities for developing and extending electronic control and enforcement of the restraining order in order to improve the effectiveness of the restraining order and to reduce infringements of the restraining order will be assessed.
fi-hanke-636603be.t: Evaluation of the e-control reform of the restraining order

fi-hanke-6380421a.f: Government proposal to improve the environmental regulation of mines
fi-hanke-6380421a.s: The project complements the regulation of extractive waste and extends the scope of the guarantees required from mines under the Environmental Protection Act, while reforming the regulatory framework governing the plans for the protection of the environment in mines, and exploring how to promote a safe environment-friendly circular economy for extractive waste.
fi-hanke-6380421a.t: To improve the environmental regulation of mines

fi-hanke-63d3daac.s: According to the European Commission's work programme for 2026, the legal framework for the fight against organised crime is to be strengthened and a legislative proposal on this subject is to be submitted in the second half of 2026.
fi-hanke-63d3daac.t: Reform of the EU Framework Decision on combating organised crime (EU preparation)

fi-hanke-64ea1842.s: The Finnish legislation on communicable diseases will be reformed during the years 2023-2025. The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health sets up a steering group and a preparatory group for the project. The aim is to strengthen the fight against communicable diseases and to strengthen preparedness for epidemics and pandemics.
fi-hanke-64ea1842.t: Total reform of the infectious disease bill

fi-hanke-66d20861.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on property tax valuation reform
fi-hanke-66d20861.s: The need to reform the valuation criteria for real estate is driven by the already known and more detailed problems highlighted in various studies in relation to the largely outdated valuation criteria currently in place.
fi-hanke-66d20861.t: Legislative framework for the reform of property tax valuation

fi-hanke-69c54ab4.s: Assess the need to update the regulation against the population.
fi-hanke-69c54ab4.t: Revision of the regulation on excitation against the population group

fi-hanke-6a875f2f.s: The project proposes to amend § 227 of the SVPL in order to terminate the obligation to transfer Yle's radio software, including a transitional period for the entry into force of the amendment, and to prepare minor, technical amendments and additions to the law relating to Articles 49, 294 and 304 of the Act.
fi-hanke-6a875f2f.t: The obligation to transfer television and radio programmes (Must Carry)

fi-hanke-6ad35cd6.t: Legislative project on Customs Criminal Intelligence (Phase 2)

fi-hanke-6aee5fe8.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of the markets in agricultural products
fi-hanke-6aee5fe8.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of the markets in agricultural products

fi-hanke-6cc49780.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 21 of the Act on the Safety of the Handling of Dangerous Chemicals and Explosives and the Safety Clearing Act in order to prepare for security threats
fi-hanke-6cc49780.s: In June 2017 (30 June 2017 to 30 November 2017), the TEM set up a working group to examine the needs for the development of the safety of the handling of dangerous chemicals and explosives in order to prepare for criminal activity and the threat of terrorism. The working group also had to submit a proposal for the necessary legislative measures.
fi-hanke-6cc49780.t: amending section 21 of the Act on the Safety of the Handling of Dangerous Chemicals and Explosives and the Safety Clearing Act to prepare for security threats

fi-hanke-6d87c5f6.s: The aim of the EU artificial intelligence regulation is to ensure that the systems of artificial intelligence introduced and put into service in the EU do not endanger human health, safety or fundamental rights, and the aim of the task force is to be responsible for the planning and preparation of the actions needed to implement the artificial intelligence regulation at national level.
fi-hanke-6d87c5f6.t: Working Party on the National Implementation of the EU Artificial Intelligence Regulation

fi-hanke-6f60261b.s: The project aims to reform the provisions on foreclosure and simplify the foreclosure of social security benefits, and to clarify other needs for changes in the foreclosure cycle.

fi-hanke-7030f239.s: The project will make a proposal to introduce a provision on the revision of permit regulations into the Environmental Protection Act (527/2014).
fi-hanke-7030f239.t: Restoration of the procedure for the revision of the permit provisions of the Environmental Protection Act

fi-hanke-725946ac.s: Opinions were requested on the draft opinion from 9 March to 4 May 2026.

fi-hanke-73ee6bf9.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Combinations of Travel Services
fi-hanke-73ee6bf9.s: The new Directive (EU) 2026/1024 of the European Parliament and of the Council amends the existing Travel Package Directive, which aims not only to provide more effective protection for passengers, but also to simplify and clarify certain provisions which have proved problematic.
fi-hanke-73ee6bf9.t: Amendment of the Act on Combinations of Travel Services

fi-hanke-752241d4.f: Government proposal to terminate the Energy Charter Treaty
fi-hanke-752241d4.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland give its consent to Finland denouncing the Treaty on the European Energy Charter signed in Lisbon in 1994 and the Protocol on environmental aspects.

fi-hanke-76196ea8.s: The project prepares legislative changes enabling the disposal of buildings identified for sale in the Finnish Forest Board's building stock project. The changes concern an estimated five national parks. The content and timetable will be revised as the Finnish Forest Board's building stock project progresses. The project includes a proposal from the Board of Directors of 1 -3.
fi-hanke-76196ea8.t: Changes in the regulations of nature conservation areas related to the Finnish Forest Board's construction stock project

fi-hanke-7642eb69.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending section 97 of the Act on Electrical Safety and Pressure Equipment
fi-hanke-7642eb69.s: Explore the development needs of the regulatory framework for electrical safety in the Defence Forces and prepare a proposal for the necessary provisions, including the need for amendments to section 97 of the Defence Forces Pressure Equipment Act.
fi-hanke-7642eb69.t: As a law amending section 97 of the Act on Electrical Safety and Pressure Equipment

fi-hanke-79b4ba6d.s: The working group assessed and clarified some of the open issues related to the reform of the Åland Act of Self-Government and prepared a proposal for a government proposal to amend the Act of Self-Government. Both reports were requested for opinions. The further preparation of the Act of Amendment takes place in official work.
fi-hanke-79b4ba6d.t: The Åland Act of Self-Government Study and Change Working Group (HE Act amending the Åland Act of Self-Government)

fi-hanke-7bdce790.s: According to the government programme, refugee espionage is punishable as a common criminal offence, and the government programme is also criminalised for acts of harmful intelligence activity, which is carried out by the government's proposal.
fi-hanke-7bdce790.t: Criminalisation of criminal activities in the field of illegal intelligence and refugee espionage

fi-hanke-7cd6b4ea.f: Government proposal to amend the Electricity Market Act (implementation of the new EU electricity market design)
fi-hanke-7cd6b4ea.s: National implementation of the EU legislative package on electricity market design (2 directives and 3 regulations) to improve consumer protection in the electricity market and to promote investment in clean energy in the electricity market.
fi-hanke-7cd6b4ea.t: Act amending the Electricity Market Act (implementation of the new EU electricity market design)

fi-hanke-7e8d52bf.f: Government proposal for temporary amendment of the infectious disease law
fi-hanke-7e8d52bf.s: It proposes to extend the provisional provisions of certain infectious diseases legislation to prevent the spread of the Covid-19 epidemic.
fi-hanke-7e8d52bf.t: Temporary amendment of the infectious disease law

fi-hanke-8027c856.s: The Ministry of Employment and the Economy has set up a working group to prepare the national legislation necessary for the implementation of the so-called "EU forced labour regulation ', which has a mandate of 15.9.2025-31.8.2026.
fi-hanke-8027c856.t: National implementation of the EU Regulation on forced labour

fi-hanke-81b4e49b.f: Government proposal to amend water law (offshore wind construction and demolition project)
fi-hanke-81b4e49b.s: The Water Act (587/2011) provides for a water permit for offshore wind power plants to be added to the provisions on maritime construction, dismantling and, possibly, landing security, partly referring to the Construction Act (751/2023).
fi-hanke-81b4e49b.t: Law amending the Water Act (offshore wind construction and demolition project)

fi-hanke-81e72dc0.f: Presentation by the Government of the Ministry of the Interior as responsible authority for the EU's secure communications programme and the GOVSATCOM component of the Space Programme
fi-hanke-81e72dc0.s: The project is designed to identify an appropriate regulatory model for the national deployment of GOVSATCOM and secure connections.
fi-hanke-81e72dc0.t: Ministry of the Interior as responsible authority in the EU's secure communications programme and in the GOVSATCOM component of the Space Programme

fi-hanke-81fea6db.s: To carry out the assessment required by the Committee on Constitutional Affairs on the functioning of the constitutional decision-making procedure in the context of NATO membership.
fi-hanke-81fea6db.t: Assess the functioning of the constitutional framework for foreign and security policy decision-making in the context of NATO membership

fi-hanke-82adb403.s: Updating the provisions on liability of public bodies.

fi-hanke-82b58ad6.f: Government proposal for national implementation of the Urban Waste Water Directive
fi-hanke-82b58ad6.s: Preparation of amendments to national legislation required by the recast Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive; environmental protection law, water management law, health protection law, infectious disease law, and possibly civil engineering law, circular economy law and energy efficiency law.
fi-hanke-82b58ad6.t: National implementation of the Urban Waste Water Directive

fi-hanke-83369c46.s: The JÄLKI project is preparing a proposal for a law on cooperation between certain municipalities in the organisation of the post-mortem control of major ship oil and ship chemical damage in the maritime area, while at the same time it is proposed to amend section 111a of the Rescue Act to include provisions on the obligation to organise ship chemical damage.
fi-hanke-83369c46.t: Preparatory work on the regulatory response to ship oil and ship chemical damage

fi-hanke-851ebafc.s: In cooperation with the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of the Interior, a project has been launched to prepare changes to transfer custody tasks for all prisoners of investigation to the Criminal Sanctions Agency, including the reform of the prison transport legislation.
fi-hanke-851ebafc.t: Reform of the prison transport legislation and transfer of prisoners of investigation to the premises of the Criminal Sanctions Agency

fi-hanke-866797f5.s: The report proposes to introduce a new law on the mortgage and mortgage of ships, aircraft and vehicles as collateral for debt, replacing the existing separate laws on different means of transport, which would be applicable to registered and typically commercial means of transport, and which would introduce a lien in the fixing of means of transport.
fi-hanke-866797f5.t: Harmonization of means of transport anchorages

fi-hanke-86b7c5c8.f: Government proposal for temporary amendment of the infectious disease law
fi-hanke-86b7c5c8.s: The infectious diseases Act would provide for a new quarantine ground for covid-19 disease for persons arriving in Finland from high-risk countries. When deciding on quarantine, the negative results of tests carried out for the detection of covid-19 disease and the duration of the person's stay in Finland could be taken into account.
fi-hanke-86b7c5c8.t: Temporary amendment of the infectious disease law

fi-hanke-88077de6.s: The Ministry of Finance has set up a working group whose main task is to develop a Community-style fund structure in Finland, which is consistent with international operating models. The working group sets up two sub-groups in support of its work, one on corporate structure issues and the other on tax matters. The working group prepares its proposal in the form of a proposal from the Board of Directors.

fi-hanke-88833861.s: Implement the European Commission's proposals on the modernisation of VAT in the digital age (the digital VAT package).
fi-hanke-88833861.t: Modernisation of VAT in the digital age (Digital VAT)

fi-hanke-8953462d.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland concerning the entry into force of the Council Decision amending the Act concerning the election of Members of the Parliament of Finland by direct universal suffrage
fi-hanke-8953462d.s: The motion proposes that the Parliament of Finland adopt the Council Decision amending the Act on the election of Members of the Parliament of Finland by direct universal suffrage, which concerns the replacement arrangements for the maternity leave of MEPs.
fi-hanke-8953462d.t: on the entry into force of the Council Decision amending the Act concerning the election of Members of the European Parliament by direct universal suffrage

fi-hanke-89c45c86.f: Government proposal to amend the Rail Transport Act and the Transport Services Act (Track Capacity)
fi-hanke-89c45c86.s: The aim of the Government's proposal is to make legislative changes to the Rail Transport Act under the Infrastructure Capacity Regulation.
fi-hanke-89c45c86.t: Act amending the Rail Transport Act and the Transport Services Act (Track Capacity)

fi-hanke-8a6ac838.s: Finland applied for membership of NATO on 17 May 2022. On 5 July, the NATO countries signed the Accession Protocol for Finland's accession to NATO, when Finland became a NATO observer member. After ratification by all Member States of the Accession Protocol and the adoption of Finland's national membership, Finland became a member of NATO on 4 April 2023. Although accession to the Nordic Atlantic Treaty is not already underway
fi-hanke-8a6ac838.t: Changes in the administrative field of the Ministry of Defence due to Finnish NATO membership

fi-hanke-8ac628e6.f: Government proposal to amend the Criminal Damage Act
fi-hanke-8ac628e6.s: The project is preparing to amend the Criminal Damage Act.
fi-hanke-8ac628e6.t: Amendment of the Criminal Damage Act

fi-hanke-8af13377.s: The EU Restoration Regulation obliges Member States to ensure that the habitat status of the habitat type or species is not deteriorated after its restoration, in other words that no action must be taken in the area that would jeopardise the survival of the good status achieved, and that there should not be any significant deterioration in unrestored habitat deposits that are already in good condition or that are in good condition.
fi-hanke-8af13377.t: Identification and preparation of legislative needs arising from the Restoration Regulation

fi-hanke-8b2c227a.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the formation of certain State-owned areas into national parks and natural parks
fi-hanke-8b2c227a.s: The project proposes to transform certain state-owned areas into national parks and nature parks to extend the Eastern Gulf of Finland National Park to maritime areas, which would include approximately 63 000 hectares of surrounding islands and islands of the National Park.
fi-hanke-8b2c227a.t: Act amending the Act on the formation of certain State-owned areas as national parks and natural parks

fi-hanke-8b87524c.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for vehicle tax and related laws
fi-hanke-8b87524c.s: The proposal introduces a new vehicle tax law and amends the vehicle law and the fuel tax law.
fi-hanke-8b87524c.t: As vehicle tax law and related laws

fi-hanke-8f4d5a66.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Fisheries Act
fi-hanke-8f4d5a66.s: The proposal introduces a new section 7a in the Fisheries Act, which provides that general fishing rights within the meaning of section 7 of the Act should not be used for commercial fishing, and proposes that the law be amended to remove the exception allowing the sale of a small quantity of fish or crab to leisure fishermen.

fi-hanke-8f57ddac.f: The Board's proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending section 137 of the Local Government Act
fi-hanke-8f57ddac.s: According to the budget statements of Prime Minister Orpo's Board of Directors 1.9.2026, the Ministry of Finance is preparing a proposal for a change to the municipal law to limit the right to appeal against the sale of residential property between a private person and a municipality to the parties concerned. The proposal will be made during autumn 2026.
fi-hanke-8f57ddac.t: Act amending section 137 of the Local Government Act

fi-hanke-8f65a836.f: Government proposal to clarify legislation on the retention of certain electronic communications transmission data for public authorities' needs
fi-hanke-8f65a836.s: The project proposes to amend sections 157 and 158 of the Electronic Communications Services Act, as well as any other legislation, in line with the case law of the EU Court of Justice on the retention of electronic communications transmission data and the use of public authorities, which makes it necessary to clarify national legislation.
fi-hanke-8f65a836.t: In order to specify the legislation on the retention of certain electronic communications transmission data for the purpose of regulatory needs

fi-hanke-8faac772.f: Government proposal to enforce the Labour Vacation Agreement with South Korea
fi-hanke-8faac772.s: Preparation of the Government's proposal to implement the employment leave agreement to be agreed between Finland and South Korea. The Board's proposal is expected to be adopted in autumn 2026.
fi-hanke-8faac772.t: on the enforcement of the Labour Vacation Agreement with South Korea

fi-hanke-8ff6a190.s: The aim is to develop and modernise the system of self-government.
fi-hanke-8ff6a190.t: Reform of the Åland Act on Self-Government

fi-hanke-912e0465.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for the reform of tax legislation on limited partnership funds
fi-hanke-912e0465.t: Reform of tax legislation on limited partnership funds

fi-hanke-92d084f0.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on valuable data sets
fi-hanke-92d084f0.s: The open data Directive (EU) 2019/1024 concerns procedures and conditions for the re-use of public sector public documents, which should be made available in machine-readable form and free of charge, and the European Commission will define valuable data files by means of implementing acts.

fi-hanke-931bb6ec.s: The legislative project will examine the need for amendments to the military law and in particular to the provisions on military members of the courts and prepare the necessary legislative changes.
fi-hanke-931bb6ec.t: Reform of the law on military litigation

fi-hanke-9477e2e4.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to reform the Unemployment Fund Act and the Act on the financing of unemployment benefits
fi-hanke-9477e2e4.s: The project takes into account the initiatives taken by the Ministry of Social Affairs and Health of the Financial Supervisory Authority in 2013 to reform the Unemployment Fund Act, which have not been implemented previously, while the provisions on the eligibility of the Employment Fund are being revised.
fi-hanke-9477e2e4.t: Legislation for the reform of the Unemployment Fund Act and the Act on the financing of unemployment benefits

fi-hanke-95c19878.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on police criminal investigations and thus to improve police access to information on internal security threats related to police tasks.
fi-hanke-95c19878.t: Legislative project on police criminal intelligence legislation and related legislation, Phase 2

fi-hanke-961018f0.s: A study project under the Criminal Policy Action Programme will be carried out to explore the possibilities of increasing the use of the probation and the use of supervised trial freedom in short prison sentences.
fi-hanke-961018f0.t: Exploring the increased use of enforcement sanctions and supervised trial freedom

fi-hanke-9819a103.s: The project will assess the timeliness of the provisions on civil liability, which will continue to be prepared in the framework of the project on the reform of the provisions on civil liability in criminal matters and the national implementation of the anti-corruption directive (project OM066: 00/2025).
fi-hanke-9819a103.t: Evaluation of the provisions on criminal liability

fi-hanke-99757db5.f: Government proposal to amend the Act on Authorised Industrial Ombudsmen
fi-hanke-99757db5.s: The legislative project is intended to make minor changes to the procedure for applying for and granting authorisation, and to consider the transfer of an appeal against the rejection of an agent's examination from administrative rights to market law.
fi-hanke-99757db5.t: amending the Act on Authorised Industrial Ombudsmen

fi-hanke-9a8ae543.s: The aim of the reform is to bring the law on preparedness into line with the modern perception of the overall security of society and its threats, as well as the identification of situations of threats and disturbances with different consequences.
fi-hanke-9a8ae543.t: Overall reform of the Capacities Act

fi-hanke-9ae14dd9.s: The government's draft aims to provide for national legislation to complement the implementation of the EU Artificial Intelligence Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) (implementation of Phase II), which only concerns the implementation of the prior authorisation procedure for ex post biometric remote identification as required by Article 26 (10) of the Artificial Intelligence Regulation.
fi-hanke-9ae14dd9.t: Additional referral: Draft government proposal to amend the Act on the supervision of certain artificial intelligence systems - Authorisation procedure for post-biometric remote identification

fi-hanke-9b06f18b.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the Central Data Register
fi-hanke-9b06f18b.s: The government's proposal proposes to introduce a requirement for data centres to register to maintain the industry's situation picture, which would provide authorities with a more comprehensive and forward-looking picture of the investment in the data centre.

fi-hanke-9b471bfc.f: Government proposal to complement implementation of the Accessibility Directive
fi-hanke-9b471bfc.s: To make the necessary additions to the implementation of the Accessibility Directive (2019 / 882 / EU) by amending the law on product accessibility requirements and the Digital Services Act, while assessing other possible needs for change.
fi-hanke-9b471bfc.t: Complementing the implementation of the Accessibility Directive

fi-hanke-9c577462.s: The Prime Minister Orpo's government programme outlines the following: strengthening the export promotion structures and the role of Finnvera in supporting exports; and implementing a comprehensive legislative reform on Finnvera. A working group has been set up to support this overall reform of legislation.
fi-hanke-9c577462.t: Overall revision of Finnvera legislation - Working Party

fi-hanke-9cc761f9.f: Government proposal to enforce the employment leave agreement with Australia
fi-hanke-9cc761f9.s: Preparation of the Board's proposal to implement the employment leave agreement already concluded between Finland and Australia in 2002. The Board's proposal is expected to be presented in autumn 2026.
fi-hanke-9cc761f9.t: on the enforcement of the employment permit concluded with Australia

fi-hanke-9cc79c9f.f: Government bill amending the Act on the reception of applicants for international protection and on the identification and assistance of victims of trafficking
fi-hanke-9cc79c9f.s: The project will prepare amendments to the Act on the Reception of applicants for international protection and the identification and assistance of victims of trafficking in human beings (746/2011), which will implement the objectives set out in the Government Programme, during which Directive (EU) 2024/1346 will be implemented in the Member States for the reception of applicants for international protection.
fi-hanke-9cc79c9f.t: Act amending the Act on the Reception of Applicants for International Protection and on the Identification and Assistance of Victims of Trafficking

fi-hanke-9dd6cb93.f: Government bill amending the Act on the Control of the Electricity and Natural Gas Markets and section 3 of the Electricity Market Act
fi-hanke-9dd6cb93.t: amending the Act on the supervision of the electricity and natural gas markets and section 3 of the Act on the electricity and gas markets

fi-hanke-9e4ffb8c.s: The project prepares a government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the national implementation of the directives on the European disability card and the parking card for disabled persons, in particular as regards the European disability card.
fi-hanke-9e4ffb8c.t: National implementation of the Directives on the European disability card and on the parking card for disabled persons

fi-hanke-a18b86db.f: Government proposal to amend the Consular Service Act
fi-hanke-a18b86db.s: The project will examine consular services provided by delegations from the point of view of the exercise of public authority and implement the necessary amendments to the consular service law.
fi-hanke-a18b86db.t: Amendment of the Consular Services Act

fi-hanke-a259b4c7.f: Government proposal to amend the hunting law and the Foreign Species Risk Management Act
fi-hanke-a259b4c7.s: Amendment of the hunting law so that the law would no longer apply to canadas and Japanese deer, which are defined by European Union legislation as harmful alien species; technical amendment to section 42 of the hunting law; review of the necessary amendments to the law on the management of risks arising from alien species.
fi-hanke-a259b4c7.t: amending the Act on Hunting and the Act on the Management of Risks of Alien Species

fi-hanke-a2ae5987.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of amendments to Chapters 9 and 10 of Chapter 2a of the Unemployment Security Act
fi-hanke-a2ae5987.s: - The unemployment security sanctions provided for in the Unemployment Security Act (1290/2002) on job search, the job seeker's service process and the job search and employment support services would be amended.
fi-hanke-a2ae5987.t: amending sections 9 and 10 of Chapter 2a of the Unemployment Security Act

fi-hanke-a5c555fb.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending the Labour Contract Act and the Maritime Labour Contract Act (sickness pay)
fi-hanke-a5c555fb.s: Implementation of the government programme record. The Board of Directors agreed on the waiver of the first day of sickness from unpaid work (Government Council / Government negotiations on the budgetary plan 22-23 April 2025).
fi-hanke-a5c555fb.t: Act amending the Labour Contract Act and the Maritime Labour Contract Act (sickness pay)

fi-hanke-a69e16c1.s: The Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the Russian Federation have decided to amend the Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the Russian Federation on Direct International Rail Transport, which entered into force on 22 December 2016.
fi-hanke-a69e16c1.t: Treaty amending the Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Finland and the Government of the Russian Federation on direct international rail transport

fi-hanke-a6e6de4a.s: The "Preparedness and Preparedness" sub-task group on the overall reform of health legislation addresses the preparedness and preparedness of health surveillance. The sub-group supports the work of the Steering Group in preparing the project's valuation memo and the Board's proposal.
fi-hanke-a6e6de4a.t: Overall reform of health legislation: Preparedness and preparedness sub-group

fi-hanke-a79fbbdc.s: The working group will deal with the whole issue of flexible use of personnel and military personnel outside the Finnish territory. The project will examine, for example, the status of personnel and the conditions of employment.
fi-hanke-a79fbbdc.t: Preparation of the Board's proposal; flexible use of staff (NATO legislative changes)

fi-hanke-a7e261e7.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Law on Construction and the Act on the Demonstration of Qualifications for Construction Planning or Management
fi-hanke-a7e261e7.s: The aim is to prepare a proposal by the Government to amend the Construction Act (751/2023) and the Act on the Certification of Qualifications for Construction Planning and Management (812/2023) in line with the objectives of the Orpo Government Programme.
fi-hanke-a7e261e7.t: amending the Law on Construction and the Act on the demonstration of competence for construction design or management tasks

fi-hanke-a899305a.s: The project implements the CBE amending Directive (EU) 2024/3237 on the cross-border exchange of information on traffic offences and Directives (EU) 2024/2841 and (EU) 2024/2842 on the establishment of a European Disability Card and a parking card for disabled persons, in so far as they provide for a parking card for disabled persons.
fi-hanke-a899305a.t: Implementation of the CBE amending Directive on the cross-border exchange of information on road safety-related traffic offences and the European parking card regulation for disabled people

fi-hanke-a9109d72.s: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has set up a working group to assess and prepare the possible needs for changes in the legal framework for private-sector cooperation and financial investment in development cooperation, as well as other possible needs for changes in development cooperation legislation.
fi-hanke-a9109d72.t: Evaluation of legislative changes in development cooperation

fi-hanke-a9c3ff77.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the General Conditions for Aid for Economic Activities
fi-hanke-a9c3ff77.s: The proposal proposes to amend Articles 3, 4 and 7 of the Act on the general conditions for granting aid to economic activities in order to improve the effectiveness of aid to enterprises, with a view to highlighting the positive economic impact of the aid criteria.
fi-hanke-a9c3ff77.t: amending the Act on the general conditions for granting aid for economic activities

fi-hanke-a9dad473.s: The project will examine consular functions related to licensing from the point of view of the exercise of public authority and will update the legislation on passport and ID cards in this respect in line with the constitutional regulation.
fi-hanke-a9dad473.t: Changes in passport and identity card legislation in the diplomatic service

fi-hanke-a9e64a71.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending the sports law and the Youth Act
fi-hanke-a9e64a71.s: Reforming the role of the expert bodies under the sports and youth laws.
fi-hanke-a9e64a71.t: Act amending the sports law and the Youth Act

fi-hanke-aca20989.s: The proposal for a directive contains rules to prevent the use of shell companies for tax avoidance purposes, while at the same time adding the necessary rules for the exchange of information on administrative cooperation in the Directive.
fi-hanke-aca20989.t: Proposal for a Council Directive on the prevention of tax abuse of shell companies

fi-hanke-ad29e2de.s: The aim of the working group is to propose changes to the rules required for the independence of the judiciary, in particular by ensuring the constitutional guarantees of the independence of the judiciary, set up and operated by a working group on the development of the judiciary set up by the Ministry of Justice in 2023.
fi-hanke-ad29e2de.t: Working Party on Constitutional Guarantees for the Independence of the judiciary

fi-hanke-ae9ba384.f: Government proposal for construction law / hearing
fi-hanke-ae9ba384.s: The proposed Construction Law would introduce a new Construction Law, repeal the existing land use and construction law, and change the name of the remaining entity into a land use law.

fi-hanke-aeba6cc6.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for laws on the amendment of fairway laws
fi-hanke-aeba6cc6.s: The project will amend the fairway laws, namely the Transport System and the Road Act (503/2005) and the Railway Act (110/2007), as well as national regulation on monitoring and risk assessment in relation to third country participation in TEN-T infrastructure projects.
fi-hanke-aeba6cc6.t: Act on the amendment of fairway laws

fi-hanke-b05a72e2.f: Government proposal to extend security clearance in ports
fi-hanke-b05a72e2.s: The Safety Clearing Act will be amended to extend the security clearance in ports.
fi-hanke-b05a72e2.t: For the extension of port security clearance

fi-hanke-b3937675.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the implementation of certain United Nations sanctions

fi-hanke-b4334322.s: The task of the working group was to prepare a proposal from the government on how to achieve the objectives set out in the overall reform of income support in the Parliament of Finland's statements and in the government records of the Government of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, which ended up presenting its conclusions in the form of a final memo.
fi-hanke-b4334322.t: Working Party on the Overall Reform of the Act on Income Support

fi-hanke-b622f809.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the State Financial Research Centre
fi-hanke-b622f809.s: The information rights of the State Economic Research Centre would be specified and specified in order to meet the current requirements of accuracy and transparency of the authority's right to information.
fi-hanke-b622f809.t: Amendment of the Law on the Financial Research Centre of the State

fi-hanke-b86f5a02.f: Government proposal for a law on the treatment of certain environment in the Government and related laws (environmental permit review by the Government)
fi-hanke-b86f5a02.s: The amendment concerns the Environmental Protection Act, the Nature Conservation Act, the Water Act and possibly the Mining Act, as well as the Act on the Safety of the Handling of Dangerous Chemicals and Explosives.
fi-hanke-b86f5a02.t: Law on the treatment of certain environmental matters in the Government and related laws (environmental permit review of the Government)

fi-hanke-bd1bc7c8.s: Finland and Norway on fishing with Norway in the Näätämöjoki river are launching negotiations for the renewal of the fishing agreement and the related fisheries regulation, which dates back to 1978 and has been amended in 1984.
fi-hanke-bd1bc7c8.t: Reform of the fishing agreement with the Näätämöjoki river

fi-hanke-bdb67303.s: The aim of the pre-study project is to assess the legal conditions under which artificial intelligence could be used at different stages of the administrative procedure of the Authority and the possible regulatory changes or new regulations that would require the use of artificial intelligence systems at different stages of the administrative procedure.
fi-hanke-bdb67303.t: Use of artificial intelligence in the administrative procedure

fi-hanke-be45e9c3.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Export Control of Dual-Use Products
fi-hanke-be45e9c3.s: The proposal would amend the law on export control of dual-use items by reforming the annex to the law containing the national control list, examining the content of the Annex and removing the regulatory overlap with Regulation 2021 / 821 of the European Parliament and of the Council directly applicable.
fi-hanke-be45e9c3.t: amending the Act on Export Control of Dual-Use Goods

fi-hanke-bf6ec87e.s: The project is intended to identify and prepare the necessary legislative changes to support the organisation and implementation of security in the State Council under all circumstances and to respond to the requirements of a changed security and operating environment, taking into account technological developments.
fi-hanke-bf6ec87e.t: Development of State Council security legislation

fi-hanke-c041a8b7.f: Presentation by the Government to the Parliament of Finland of the agreement between the US Department of Defence and the Finnish Ministry of Defence acting on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Finland on research, development, testing and evaluation projects for the adoption and entry into force of the amending document
fi-hanke-c041a8b7.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland approve an amendment agreement between the Finnish Ministry of Defence, acting on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Finland, on research, development, testing and evaluation projects, and the US Department of Defence, which extends the duration of the agreement.
fi-hanke-c041a8b7.t: Agreement between the US Department of Defence and the Finnish Ministry of Defence on research, development, testing and evaluation projects for the adoption and entry into force of the amending document, acting on behalf of the Government of the Republic of Finland

fi-hanke-c1c0aa30.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 5 of the Waste Tax Act and the Annex
fi-hanke-c1c0aa30.s: The government does not implement the planned extension of the waste tax, as the waste distribution proposed to the Directorate-General for the tax could not be sufficiently allocated to the distribution of waste produced by individual companies.
fi-hanke-c1c0aa30.t: Act amending section 5 of the Waste Tax Act and the Annex

fi-hanke-c1f98be8.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending section 9 of the Income Tax Act
fi-hanke-c1f98be8.t: Act amending section 9 of the Income Tax Act

fi-hanke-c25077ed.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Foreign Service Act
fi-hanke-c25077ed.s: A provision is added to the Foreign Affairs Act which empowers the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to have the language test carried out by an external expert, while at the same time providing for the qualifications of an external expert, criminal service and liability for damages, in accordance with section 124 of the Constitution.
fi-hanke-c25077ed.t: Act amending the Foreign Service Act

fi-hanke-c2ffbeb1.s: The task force set up by the Ministry of Justice will investigate the development of the duties of the equal opportunities officer and the equal opportunities councillor, as well as the integration of the delegates, while looking at the role and status of the senior councillor.
fi-hanke-c2ffbeb1.t: Exploring the tasks and overlaps of special delegates

fi-hanke-c3b944b4.f: Government proposal to amend sections 31 and 75 (5) ECEC
fi-hanke-c3b944b4.t: amending sections 31 and 75 (5) of the ECEC

fi-hanke-c3efe915.s: The aim of the project is to define the national target status for the collection and exploitation of public procurement information, and to assess the options for implementation in terms of the public procurement information and its content, as well as the legal requirements relating to the information reserve.
fi-hanke-c3efe915.t: National public procurement information reserve and publication of purchase invoice data

fi-hanke-c42ed83a.s: The General Health Control Sub-Working Group on the overall reform of health legislation will address the general principles of supervision, the role of public authorities, the supervisory practices of different types of activities, issues such as authorisation, notification and self-control of operators.
fi-hanke-c42ed83a.t: Overall Health Protection Law Reform: General Health Protection Sub-Working Party

fi-hanke-c524a311.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland on the adoption of the Additional Protocol to the World Health Organisation (WHO) Framework Convention on Tobacco Control to prevent illicit trade in tobacco products and on the transposition of provisions in its legislation and amending the Tobacco Act
fi-hanke-c524a311.t: approving the Additional Protocol to the World Health Organisation (WHO) Framework Convention on Tobacco Control to prevent illicit trade in tobacco products, as well as as as legislation on the enforcement of provisions in its legislation and amending the Tobacco Act

fi-hanke-c5977ad3.s: The purpose of the legislative project is to assess the need for reform and change of the law on the use of passenger name records in air transport in the fight against terrorist offences and serious crime in relation to existing EU regulation and to prepare proposals for necessary legislative changes.
fi-hanke-c5977ad3.t: Legislative project to amend the law on the use of passenger name records in air transport in the fight against terrorist offences and serious crime

fi-hanke-c5bd538b.s: The project is preparing legislative changes in three different areas of migration management: • The amount required for family members to make a living would be laid down by a decree of the Council of State; • The information would be more often disclosed on own initiative to prevent work-related abuse; • the payment card issued by Migri would be provided by law.
fi-hanke-c5bd538b.t: Legislative project amending the rules on family income limits, self-initiative on information disclosure and the payment card issued by the Migration Office

fi-hanke-c6ba58da.f: Draft legislation of the Board of Directors on changes in the duties of the Cooperation Ombudsman to the Parliament of Finland
fi-hanke-c6ba58da.s: The project examines the role and tasks of the Office of the Cooperation Ombudsman and the Cooperation Ombudsman (including the possibility to terminate and delegate tasks) and makes the necessary legislative changes.
fi-hanke-c6ba58da.t: Cooperation - legislation on changes in the duties of the Ombudsman

fi-hanke-c7da6698.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the VAT Act

fi-hanke-c9bc6c0a.f: Government proposal to change the alcohol law (supply of alcoholic beverages, distance selling and marketing)
fi-hanke-c9bc6c0a.s: The draft is part of the implementation of the government programme of the Government of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, which provides for the government's responsible reform of alcohol policy in the European direction and the continuation of the 2018 overall reform of the alcohol law, with the aim of promoting fair and open competition, and the government has agreed to a number of measures in the field of alcohol trade.
fi-hanke-c9bc6c0a.t: Act amending the Alcohol Act (supply of alcoholic beverages, distance selling and marketing)

fi-hanke-c9f7879a.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on temporary fuel subsidies for enterprises
fi-hanke-c9f7879a.s: The project is prepared by the Government's proposal for temporary aid to transport and agricultural enterprises to compensate for fuel purchases, due to the increase in world prices for oil products due to the tightening situation in the Hormuz Straits, and the sudden cost surge for companies.
fi-hanke-c9f7879a.t: Act on the temporary aid granted to undertakings for fuel

fi-hanke-cb0bcb91.f: Government proposal to implement the new Driving Licence Directive and EU driving ban rules
fi-hanke-cb0bcb91.s: The legislative project will complete the reform of the driving licence law and implement at national level the new EU Driving Licence Directive (EU) 2025/2205 and the EU driving ban rules (EU) 2025/2206. In addition to the national implementation of the new EU regulation, the legislative project will also assess the need for further amendments to the driving licence law.
fi-hanke-cb0bcb91.t: implementing the new driving licence directive and EU driving ban rules

fi-hanke-cd699943.f: Government proposal to change the Electricity Market Act
fi-hanke-cd699943.s: The aim of the proposal is to ensure appropriate and efficient exploitation of the capacity of the electricity network between competing needs in a context of limited capacity in the electricity network.
fi-hanke-cd699943.t: Act amending the Electricity Market Act

fi-hanke-cd78d749.f: Government proposal to amend the Act on the Customer Information System for Business Services
fi-hanke-cd78d749.t: amending the Act on the Customer Information System for Business Services

fi-hanke-ce8951df.s: The project will explore possible national solutions to the situation of long-term residents, as well as a report on the legislative change in the granting of an alien passport and a temporary residence permit for a limited period of time to implement the government programme.
fi-hanke-ce8951df.t: Project for residents without the right of residence

fi-hanke-cebdb2ed.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to repeal sections 10 and 11 of the Public Administration Information Act and to amend section 2 of the National Archives Act
fi-hanke-cebdb2ed.s: The proposal of the Board of Directors would propose the repeal of the regulation of the Public Administration Information Management Act on the Board of Information Management. As a result of the repeal, the Board would cease its activities from the beginning of 2027.
fi-hanke-cebdb2ed.t: Law repealing sections 10 and 11 of the Public Administration Information Act and amending section 2 of the National Archives Act

fi-hanke-cfbd7d06.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 50 of the infectious diseases Act
fi-hanke-cfbd7d06.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Act on Infectious Disease so that the Institute for Health and Welfare would also decide on the future of the economically or otherwise significant procurement of vaccines. In future, the Institute for Health and Welfare could also decide on other procurement of vaccines without the obligation to inform the STM in advance.
fi-hanke-cfbd7d06.t: Act amending section 50 of the infectious diseases Act

fi-hanke-cff84922.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 25 of the Finnish Constitution
fi-hanke-cff84922.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Finnish Constitution in respect of the division of constituencies. The proposed law would establish the division of the country for parliamentary elections into at least nine and up to fifteen constituencies. In addition, the Åland Province would continue to form its own constituency.
fi-hanke-cff84922.t: Act amending section 25 of the Finnish Constitution
