fi-hanke-d0fd57c8.s: The project is preparing the proposed amendments to the Civil Protection Code in the framework of the "Exploration of the Reform of the Rescue Act" project (SMDro 2019- 2078) and other studies, taking into account the entries of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme.
fi-hanke-d0fd57c8.t: The second phase of the rescue law reform project

fi-hanke-d146dd49.s: The project prepares a government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the national implementation of the Insurance Recovery and Resolution Directive.
fi-hanke-d146dd49.t: National implementation of the Insurance Recovery and Resolution Directive

fi-hanke-d3d29e6f.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 24 of the Act on Public Access to the Authority
fi-hanke-d3d29e6f.t: Amendment of section 24 of the Law on Public Access to the Authority

fi-hanke-d46dc44a.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on the evaluation of health care procedures
fi-hanke-d46dc44a.s: Set up the Institute for Health and Welfare to produce and collect assessments of therapeutic and economic value (HTA assessment) on medical and rehabilitation methods and on health care measures to prevent, diagnose or treat diseases.
fi-hanke-d46dc44a.t: Legislation on the evaluation of health care procedures

fi-hanke-d47091fc.s: The legislative work project has assessed the needs for change in the provisions on the selection of residents in relation to the selection of the population as a public administration, the conditions for the selection of the population, the ranking of applicants and the right of access to information for public authorities.
fi-hanke-d47091fc.t: Amendment of the provisions on the selection of residents of rental and dwelling houses supported by the State

fi-hanke-d4dd9d81.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the VAT Act (real estate investment review procedure)
fi-hanke-d4dd9d81.s: Consider the impact of the Court of Justice's judgment C-787 / 18 (Sögård Fastigheter AB) on the review process for real estate investment in Finland and submit a government proposal to amend the VAT Act to that effect.
fi-hanke-d4dd9d81.t: Act amending the VAT Act (property investment review procedure)

fi-hanke-d732cf23.s: The project implements nationally the new EU Ecodesign Regulation (EU) 2024/1781, which entered into force on 18 July 2024, as part of a sustainable product initiative to build environmental, circular economy, energy efficiency and life-cycle thinking of products and to increase product information.
fi-hanke-d732cf23.t: National implementation of the EU Ecodesign Regulation

fi-hanke-d7bd1245.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of the amendment of section 25 of the Finnish Constitution and the Election Act (constituency)
fi-hanke-d7bd1245.s: The electoral system for parliamentary elections would be reformed so that the constituency, from which fewer than eight representatives are elected, would form an electoral area for the purpose of the calculation of results with another constituency.
fi-hanke-d7bd1245.t: amending section 25 of the Finnish Constitution and the Election Act (Electoral Region)

fi-hanke-d7c7ae40.s: The task of the Working Group (21.9.2026 - 28.2.2027) is to prepare a report in the form of a government proposal containing proposals for legislative changes required for the implementation of the EWC amending Directive, which expires on 1 January 2028.
fi-hanke-d7c7ae40.t: Working Party on the National Implementation of the EWC Amendment Directive

fi-hanke-d80dc486.s: In line with the Board's framework decisions, improvements to the ASP are being prepared, the State guarantee for owner-occupied mortgage loans and the State guarantee for the renovation loans of housing companies are being prepared.
fi-hanke-d80dc486.t: Improvement of the State guarantee for mortgage loans and equity loans of housing companies and the conditions of the housing savings scheme

fi-hanke-d81877cb.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Income Tax Act, the Tax Procedure Act and the Tax Accounting Act
fi-hanke-d81877cb.t: Act amending the Income Tax Act, the Tax Procedure Act and the Tax Accounting Act

fi-hanke-d90876b0.s: The project will prepare legislative changes necessary for the national implementation of certain provisions of the EU Return Regulation.
fi-hanke-d90876b0.t: Legislative project on the national implementation of certain provisions of the EU Return Regulation

fi-hanke-da05ff15.s: The project will explore and implement changes to the residence permit procedure to prevent and combat occupational abuse, based on an action programme against occupational abuse, and will introduce changes to the seasonal labour law, with the aim of improving the level of implementation of the directive on which it is based.
fi-hanke-da05ff15.t: Legislative project to combat work-related abuse in the residence permit procedure

fi-hanke-da5b4813.f: Government proposal for the adoption and implementation of the Amending Protocol to the Council of Europe Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism
fi-hanke-da5b4813.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland adopt the Amending Protocol to the Council of Europe Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism and the Act of Implementation of the Amending Protocol.
fi-hanke-da5b4813.t: approving and implementing the Amending Protocol to the Council of Europe Convention on the Prevention of Terrorism

fi-hanke-db5f4a77.s: The project to criminalise abuse of influence will continue to be prepared in the framework of the project to reform the rules on criminal liability and to implement the anti-corruption directive at national level (project OM066: 00/2025).

fi-hanke-dc615681.f: Government bill amending section 90 of the hunting law and section 31 of the game regime law
fi-hanke-dc615681.t: Amendment of section 90 of the hunting law and section 31 of the game regime law

fi-hanke-dd1defee.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to supplement the Government's proposal amending the annex to the Vehicle Tax Act (HE 173/2026 vp)
fi-hanke-dd1defee.t: To supplement the Government's proposal amending the Annex to the Vehicle Tax Act (HE 173/2026 vp)

fi-hanke-dd1f5e9a.f: Government proposal for hydrogen market laws and related laws (implementation of the EU gas package)
fi-hanke-dd1f5e9a.s: To adopt the hydrogen market law and complement the natural gas market law and energy market surveillance legislation with the changes required by the new EU gas legislation, which will move to autumn 2027.
fi-hanke-dd1f5e9a.t: Hydrogen market laws and related laws (EU gas package implementation)

fi-hanke-dd3b2e45.s: The reform of the Public Service Act aims to achieve a general law that regulates the public policy of public authorities more clearly and effectively, with the aim of preparing a government proposal that balances the transparency and confidentiality needs of public authorities, in which the needs for updating the Public Service Act have been assessed in a comprehensive manner.

fi-hanke-de2f6fa4.s: The task of the working group (29.1.- 31.12.2025, informal extension 6/2026) is to prepare a report in the form of a government proposal containing proposals for the legislative changes required for the implementation of the Directive, which will expire on 2 December 2026.
fi-hanke-de2f6fa4.t: Working Party on the National Implementation of the PSD

fi-hanke-df500404.f: Government proposal for a law on location information for underground network infrastructure
fi-hanke-df500404.s: The development and implementation of a system for responding to requests for a position report would require amendments to the law on facilitating the deployment of very high capacity networks, for which a government proposal is to be submitted to the Parliament of Finland during the spring session of 2025.
fi-hanke-df500404.t: As a law on location information for underground network infrastructure

fi-hanke-df82d063.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Waste Act, Part II 2023-2026 (improvement of competition neutrality)
fi-hanke-df82d063.s: The Waste Act makes the necessary changes to the provisions on competition neutrality in municipal waste management, taking into account the Government programme's entries on the clarification of secondary responsibility of municipalities and on the tightening of the exit limit.
fi-hanke-df82d063.t: Act amending the Waste Act, Part II 2023-2026 (Improving competition neutrality)

fi-hanke-e0203c27.f: Draft legislation by the Government to the Parliament of Finland supplementing the EU Gigabit Regulation
fi-hanke-e0203c27.s: The project implements the EU's so-called Gigabit Regulation (EU) 2024/1309 on measures to reduce the cost of the deployment of the gigabit-level electronic communications networks, amending Regulation (EU) 2015/2120 and repealing Directive 2014 / 61 / EU).
fi-hanke-e0203c27.t: Complementary legislation to the EU Gigabit Regulation

fi-hanke-e092e939.f: Government proposal to amend the Financial Stability Authority Act
fi-hanke-e092e939.s: The project will prepare a proposal from the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland, which will make the necessary changes to the law on the Financial Stability Authority and its Annex following the new EBA Guidelines on risk-based calculation of deposit guarantee payments in 2023.
fi-hanke-e092e939.t: amending the Financial Stability Authority Act

fi-hanke-e0ed1ec4.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the VAT Act (part 2 of the Digiaian VAT Act)
fi-hanke-e0ed1ec4.t: Act amending the VAT Act (part 2 of the Digia'

fi-hanke-e1f05cdd.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland supplementing the Government's proposal to amend the Law on the temporary support for the acquisition of an alternative propulsion vehicle and the conversion of a vehicle into an alternative propulsion vehicle
fi-hanke-e1f05cdd.s: The proposal would supplement the Government's proposal to amend the Procurement and Conversion Aid Act 1289/2021 in order to reflect the changing legal basis of EU State aid law, i.e. amendments to the de minimis Regulation.
fi-hanke-e1f05cdd.t: supplementing the Government's proposal to amend the law on the temporary support for the acquisition of an alternative propulsion vehicle and the conversion of a vehicle to an alternative propulsion vehicle

fi-hanke-e2a38768.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the organisation of development cooperation
fi-hanke-e2a38768.s: The proposal proposes to introduce a new law on the organisation of development cooperation, which brings together provisions on the organisation of the preparatory and implementation tasks of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs within and outside the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
fi-hanke-e2a38768.t: The law on the organisation of development cooperation

fi-hanke-e42e70f7.s: The project will implement the reform of the rules on criminal liability and implement the EU's so-called anti-corruption directive at national level.
fi-hanke-e42e70f7.t: Reform of the provisions on criminal liability and national implementation of the Anti-Corruption Directive

fi-hanke-e57d8e02.s: The Ministry of Education and Culture will appoint a working group to prepare measures to promote educational equality and positive special treatment in early childhood education, pre-primary and primary education.
fi-hanke-e57d8e02.t: Preparatory Working Party on Education and Training (PD- VOS) on the Right to Learn

fi-hanke-e86d46df.s: The aim of the project is to simplify and streamline maritime regulation, in particular the regulation of occupation and qualifications, and to promote the productivity of the Transport and Communications Agency.
fi-hanke-e86d46df.t: Legislative project to streamline maritime regulation

fi-hanke-e9910439.s: The proposal amends the Act on the participation of civil persons in crisis management and the Civil Service Act.
fi-hanke-e9910439.t: Revision of the regulation of annual leave in employment as provided for in the Civil Crisis Management Act

fi-hanke-e99fc249.f: Government proposal to promote renewable fuels in air transport
fi-hanke-e99fc249.s: The new law would provide for a national obligation to distribute air transport.
fi-hanke-e99fc249.t: Act on the promotion of renewable fuels in air transport

fi-hanke-ea57651a.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Act on the State Contribution of the Local Government to Basic Services and related laws
fi-hanke-ea57651a.s: reform the state-owned system of municipal basic services to ensure as far as possible the funding of municipal government-owned activities in the wake of the war reform and the TE- reform, which also aims at increasing the clarity and comprehensibility of the State-owned system;
fi-hanke-ea57651a.t: Act amending the Act on the State Contribution to Basic Services of the Municipality and related laws

fi-hanke-ecc01cff.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Nicaragua
fi-hanke-ecc01cff.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the exercise of their traffic.
fi-hanke-ecc01cff.t: Agreement on air transport with the Republic of Nicaragua

fi-hanke-ed4d9917.s: The project will draw up legislative proposals on the determination and allocation of the fee to be assigned to the authority responsible for the ex-ante guidance of the Agency.
fi-hanke-ed4d9917.t: Legislative project on charging for the task of ex-ante guidance and co-operation of the State Authorisation and Control Agency to be set up

fi-hanke-edfd34ed.s: It is proposed that a new discretionary employment service mission be set up to provide funding to associations and foundations for project activities aimed at promoting the general conditions for job search and employment for long-term unemployed people.
fi-hanke-edfd34ed.t: Development of employment services: Employment policy support

fi-hanke-ee743d27.s: The task of the working group is to prepare possible legislative changes to improve compliance with payment time legislation as objectives, in particular to strengthen the capacity of small and medium-sized enterprises.
fi-hanke-ee743d27.t: Improving compliance with payment time legislation

fi-hanke-f02153c7.f: Draft legislation by the Government supplementing the Regulations of the European Parliament and of the Council on the reform of the Visa Information System
fi-hanke-f02153c7.s: Preparation of national legislation supplementing the VIS amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1134.
fi-hanke-f02153c7.t: Complementary legislation to the European Parliament and Council Regulations on the reform of the Visa Information System

fi-hanke-f13c1583.s: The Convention contains obligations to criminalise, inter alia, the counterfeiting and provision of medicines and the placing on the market of medicinal products; it also contains provisions on criminal investigations and prosecution measures, as well as provisions on cooperation between authorities and international cooperation in criminal matters; it also contains provisions on the prevention of crime.
fi-hanke-f13c1583.t: Council of Europe Convention against Counterfeiting Medicinal Products

fi-hanke-f194c92f.f: Government proposal for the approval and entry into force of an agreement on the exchange of classified information and mutual protection with the OCCAR
fi-hanke-f194c92f.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland adopt an agreement on the exchange of classified information and mutual protection with the Organisation for the Cooperation in the Armaments (OCCAR) and a law transposing the provisions of the Treaty.
fi-hanke-f194c92f.t: With a view to adopting and implementing an agreement on the exchange of classified information and mutual protection with the OCCAR

fi-hanke-f22cd269.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the implementation and control of the obligations of the EU Regulation on the reduction of methane emissions from energy and on the amendment of the Electricity Market Act
fi-hanke-f22cd269.s: Regulation (EU) No 2024/1787 of the Safety and Chemicals Agency as the competent authority required by Regulation (EU) No 2024/1787 and the penalties provided for by that Regulation for the national regime.
fi-hanke-f22cd269.t: Law on the implementation and enforcement of the obligations of the EU Regulation on the reduction of methane emissions in the energy sector and on the amendment of the Electricity Market Act

fi-hanke-f2b6becb.f: Government proposal to amend the Act on the organisation of public ICT services
fi-hanke-f2b6becb.s: The Ministry of Finance has set up a working group to produce a proposal for legislative changes to the Tori Act.
fi-hanke-f2b6becb.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of public ICT services

fi-hanke-f3c1de1a.s: Regulation (EU) 2026/1738 of the European Parliament and of the Council on the circular economy requirements for the design of vehicles and on the management of waste from end-of-life vehicles (the circular economy regulation for vehicles) entered into force on 13 August 2026. The project prepares a government proposal for its implementation.
fi-hanke-f3c1de1a.t: Implementation of the EU Vehicle Circular Economy Regulation

fi-hanke-f7a8b5a0.f: Government proposal to amend the Law on Military Intelligence (Home Peace Protection)
fi-hanke-f7a8b5a0.s: The proposal proposes that the Military Intelligence Act should include provisions on the use of certain methods of inquiry in the condition of permanent residence, with any other necessary changes to the tasks involved.
fi-hanke-f7a8b5a0.t: Act amending the Law on Military Intelligence (Home Peace Protection)

fi-hanke-f7cb4c79.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 10 of the Income Tax Act
fi-hanke-f7cb4c79.s: Paragraph 10 (10a) of the Income Tax Act is amended. This proposal would treat profits from indirect disposal of immovable property as income from Finland when transferring shares or other shares of a listed entity that are not subject to public trading.
fi-hanke-f7cb4c79.t: Act amending section 10 of the Income Tax Act

fi-hanke-f92114a3.f: Government proposal to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care (unit costs of welfare areas)
fi-hanke-f92114a3.s: The project implements a government programme record for publishing unit costs in welfare areas.
fi-hanke-f92114a3.t: amending the Act on the organisation of social and health care (unit costs in welfare areas)

fi-hanke-f9b8b820.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the Government
fi-hanke-f9b8b820.s: The proposal proposes a limited derogation from the general provisions on the date of public access to documents under the Government Act on the Government Council for certain documents held by ministries in connection with government negotiations.
fi-hanke-f9b8b820.t: Act amending the Law on the Government

fi-hanke-fbe1a393.s: Start work on the review of the Arbitration Act by drawing up an international comparison of legislation and arbitration activities in some other European countries (Sweden, Norway, Denmark, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, France and England), drawn up by the Ministry of Justice as official work.

fi-hanke-fc20f54b.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Colombia
fi-hanke-fc20f54b.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the exercise of their traffic.
fi-hanke-fc20f54b.t: Agreement on air transport with the Republic of Colombia

fi-hanke-fefa73f6.f: Government proposal to amend the Law on precious metal products
fi-hanke-fefa73f6.s: National legislation (law and regulation on precious metal products) to meet the new levels of precious metal products authorised by the CCM (Convention on the Inspection and Staffing of precious metal products) and customs as a control body under the agreement.
fi-hanke-fefa73f6.t: Act amending the Act on precious metal products

fi-he-100-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Passport and ID Card Act
fi-he-100-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare legislative proposals for a 10-year change in the maximum validity of the passport and, where possible, of the identity card, and to prepare any other necessary legislative amendments, with the aim of submitting the government's proposal to the Parliament of Finland during the autumn session of 2025.
fi-he-100-2026.t: Act amending the Passport and ID Card Act

fi-he-101-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the Salmon Damage Fund in the pig sector
fi-he-101-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the legislation needed to prepare, as a working group, for a risk management solution for salmonella damage in the pig sector, which would provide protection for salmonella in the pig sector through a fund outside the State budget.
fi-he-101-2026.t: Legal from the Salmon Damage Fund in the pig sector

fi-he-102-2020.s: The aim of the Regulation is to ensure that, in accordance with the principle of mutual recognition, Member States should recognise and implement decisions taken in other Member States in the context of criminal proceedings in the situations required by the Regulation, and in the field of judicial cooperation in criminal matters, framework decisions on the application of the principle of mutual recognition are in force (2003 / 577 / EC).
fi-he-102-2020.t: Mutual recognition of decisions on the freezing and revocation of a decision

fi-he-103-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Waste Act
fi-he-103-2024.t: Act on the amendment of the Waste Act

fi-he-103-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to reform legislation on the composition of administrative courts
fi-he-103-2026.s: The timeliness and effectiveness of the assembly provisions will be improved, inter alia, by increasing the range of assembly options, in order to provide a more flexible and appropriate response to the needs arising from different solutions.
fi-he-103-2026.t: Reform of legislation on the composition of administrative courts

fi-he-104-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on Military Intelligence and related laws
fi-he-104-2026.s: The project is designed to assess the need for changes to the provisions of the Military Intelligence Act and other accompanying acts in relation to existing legislation and the requirements of the current environment, and to prepare proposals for legislative changes on the basis of the assessment.
fi-he-104-2026.t: Act amending the Law on Military Intelligence and related laws

fi-he-105-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing and related laws
fi-he-105-2026.s: The Ministry of Finance set up a working group on 10 May 2024 - 30 June 2025 to prepare a comprehensive reform of the regulation on the prevention of money laundering and terrorist financing. The draft draft of the Board of Directors was drawn up by a set working group. After a round of opinions, the further preparation of the Board's draft proposal was carried out as an official work.
fi-he-105-2026.t: Law on the Prevention of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing and related Laws

fi-he-106-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the provision of digital services
fi-he-106-2026.s: The aim of the project is to prepare legislative proposals for legislative changes in line with the government programme, which would allow for increased automation in the provision of government advice in digital services, and to remove the barriers to the exploitation of autonomous technologies, in particular by section 6a of the Digital Services Act.
fi-he-106-2026.t: amending the Act on the provision of digital services

fi-he-107-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on e-business of the estate
fi-he-107-2026.s: The report of the working group and the legislative proposals contained in the report prepared by the legislative group on the 'Easy to manage' programme of the late family member were on the Opinion Service.fi's website at the turn of the year 2025-2026. The government's proposal was submitted to the Parliament of Finland on 4 June 2026. The legislation would enter into force on 1 February 2027.
fi-he-107-2026.t: Legal framework for e-business of the estate

fi-he-109-2026.f: Draft legislation of the Board of Directors amending the General Aid Act, the Law on the organisation of employment services and the Law on General Language Qualifications
fi-he-109-2026.s: The task of the working group on integration support and language support for labour market support is to prepare legislative measures to implement government programme records on integration support and linguistic assistance for Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government.
fi-he-109-2026.t: amending the General Aid Act, the Labour Services Act and the General Law on Language Qualifications

fi-he-11-2022.s: It is proposed to insert a new article in the Foreign Law providing for the security features of a visa, which would implement the Commission Implementing Decision on the uniform format of a visa adopted under the Council Regulation establishing a single format for visas.

fi-he-11-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Competition and Consumer Protection
fi-he-11-2024.s: The project aims to prepare national regulation related to the Digital Market Act (Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 of the European Parliament and of the Council), although it is a directly applicable EU regulation, it is necessary to adopt complementary national regulation to ensure its effective and effective implementation.
fi-he-11-2024.t: Act amending the Competition and Consumer Protection Act

fi-he-110-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Medical Research, the Law on Clinical Research and the Biobank Act and to become certain other laws
fi-he-110-2026.s: The project will clarify the legislation on military research activities by identifying the needs for correction, change and coordination of existing regulation and by taking the necessary measures.
fi-he-110-2026.t: amending the Act on Medical Research, the Law on Clinical Research and the Law on Biobank and into certain other laws

fi-he-111-2026.f: Presentation by the Government to the Parliament of Finland of the adoption and implementation of amendments to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court in 2017 and 2019
fi-he-111-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court in 2017 and 2019; Amendment of Article 8 of the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court
fi-he-111-2026.t: With a view to adopting and implementing the amendments to the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court in 2017 and 2019

fi-he-113-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Social Welfare Act, the Act on Support for the Capacity of the Older Population and the Act on Social and Health Services for Older People and the Act on Social and Health Care Customer Fees
fi-he-113-2025.s: The aim of the presentation is to provide for the use of technology in social services and for the technology to be taken into account in calculating the 24-hour personnel dimensions of older people.
fi-he-113-2025.t: Act amending the Social Welfare Act, the Act on Support for the Capacity of the Older Population and the Act on Social and Health Services for Older People and the Act on Social and Health Care Customer Fees

fi-he-115-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on basic art education and related laws
fi-he-115-2026.s: Under the programme of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's Government (2023), reform of the legislation on basic art education is proposed with the aim of improving the accessibility of teaching, taking into account the different fields of art.
fi-he-115-2026.t: Law on Basic Art Education and Related Laws

fi-he-116-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for adoption and implementation of the Second Additional Protocol to the World Postal Union Convention and for the Law amending section 77 of the Postal Act
fi-he-116-2026.s: The aim of the project is to bring into force the Second Additional Protocol to the World Postal Union Convention and its provisions under its legislation at legal level and to take other measures necessary for national transposition.
fi-he-116-2026.t: With a view to adopting and implementing the Second Additional Protocol to the World Postal Union Convention and amending section 77 of the Postal Act

fi-he-117-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 50 of the Civil Service Act and the Security Clearance Act
fi-he-117-2026.s: The project is preparing amendments to the State Civil Service Act (750/1994).
fi-he-117-2026.t: Act amending section 50 of the Civil Service Act and the Security Clearing Act

fi-he-118-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the annual leave law and become other laws
fi-he-118-2026.s: The working group will prepare the legislative changes required by the government's mid-term review to regulate savings free, which may invite experts, draw up its report in the form of a government proposal and submit its report to the Ministry for further preparation.
fi-he-118-2026.t: The law of changing the annual leave law and making certain other laws

fi-he-119-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Financing of Unemployment Benefits
fi-he-119-2025.t: Act amending the Act on the financing of unemployment benefits

fi-he-119-2026.f: Draft arbitration and related laws of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-119-2026.s: Under the government programme, the needs for the reform of the Arbitration Act are clarified and the necessary legislative changes are prepared to promote the competitiveness of Finnish arbitration activities. The Arbitration Act is technically modernised to reflect best international practices.

fi-he-120-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the law of imprisonment and related laws
fi-he-120-2026.s: The project will continue to develop the Penitentiary Act and the Penitentiary Act (first project OM039: 00/2021), which will further examine the needs for the amendment of that legislation, assessing the need for the amendment of the Penitentiary Act and the Penitentiary Act, and preparing the necessary amendments to the provisions.
fi-he-120-2026.t: Act amending the Act of imprisonment and related laws

fi-he-121-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the processing of personal data by police, the Act on the processing of personal data by immigration authorities, section 131 of the Foreign Code and section 1 of Chapter 2 of the Police Act
fi-he-121-2025.s: The project is designed to assess the need for legislative change concerning the processing of biometric data stored in the passport register and the identity card register and stored in the police register pursuant to section 131 of the Foreign Code for purposes other than their original processing.
fi-he-121-2025.t: amending the Act on the processing of personal data by police, the Act on the processing of personal data in the administration of immigration, section 131 of the Foreign Code and section 1 of Chapter 2 of the Police Act

fi-he-121-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on criminal intelligence legislation
fi-he-121-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on police criminal investigations and thus to improve police access to information on internal security threats related to police tasks.

fi-he-122-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the gun law
fi-he-122-2026.s: The legislative project assesses and prepares the necessary amendments to the Firearms Act (1/1998) and the Firearms Regulation (145/1998).
fi-he-122-2026.t: Law on the modification of the firearm

fi-he-123-2026.f: The Board of Directors' draft law to the Parliament of Finland repealing certain provisions of the Enterprise and Community Information Act, section 3 (3) (11) and section 5 (26) of the Financial Supervisory Act and section 1 (7) (f) and section 10 (11) of the Financial Supervisory Supervisory Authority Charges Act
fi-he-123-2026.s: The project is preparing a law to repeal the provisions on the LEI on the Business and Community Information Act.
fi-he-123-2026.t: By repealing certain provisions of the Enterprise and Community Information Act, section 3 (3) (11) and section 5 (26) of the Financial Supervisory Act and section 1 (7) (f) and section 10 (11) of the Financial Supervisory Authority Charges Act

fi-he-124-2026.f: Draft law of the Board of Directors amending the entry into force of the General Aid Act
fi-he-124-2026.s: The proposal proposes an amendment to the general allowance for a partial early retirement pension, which would be applicable to the entry into force of the General Aid Act (48/2026), which would not take into account the partial early retirement pension as the income of the general allowance if the decision to grant the pension had been taken before 16 January 2026.
fi-he-124-2026.t: Act amending the entry into force provisions of the General Aid Act

fi-he-125-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Private Road Act
fi-he-125-2026.s: The project will prepare the necessary amendments to the Private Road Act (560/2018) to clarify the law and to clarify some of its provisions on the basis of feedback from stakeholders and, for example, to clarify the legal status of the payment of private road charges.
fi-he-125-2026.t: Act on the amendment of the Private Road Act

fi-he-126-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 6 of the State Pension Fund Act
fi-he-126-2025.t: Amendment of section 6 of the State Pension Fund Act

fi-he-126-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for laws amending the Companies Act and the Cooperative Act as well as related laws
fi-he-126-2026.s: Updating the Companies Act, starting with previous studies, to reduce the administrative burden on companies and the general conditions for business by reforming the regulation on public limited liability companies, to improve the winding-up process and the regulation on the loss of equity.
fi-he-126-2026.t: Act amending the Companies Act and the Cooperative Act and related laws

fi-he-127-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapter 25 of the Penal Code and for a number of other laws
fi-he-127-2026.s: Assess the legislative changes required and prepare for the national implementation of the amending Directive amending the Directive on trafficking in human beings (Directive (EU) 2024/1712 amending Directive 2011 / 36 / EU on the prevention and fight against trafficking in human beings and the protection of victims of trafficking).
fi-he-127-2026.t: Law on the amendment of Chapter 25 of the Criminal Code and other laws

fi-he-128-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on utility model law
fi-he-128-2026.s: In May 2022, the Ministry of Employment and the Economy set up a working group to prepare a comprehensive reform of patent law, as part of the reform, which has also assessed the utility model system and its need for the future.
fi-he-128-2026.t: Act amending the law on utility model law

fi-he-129-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the law on equality between men and women and to make related laws
fi-he-129-2026.s: The national implementation of the EU Wage and Transparency Directive (EU) 2023 / 970 proposes amendments to the Equal Opportunities Act and related laws.
fi-he-129-2026.t: Act amending the Law on equality between men and women and related laws

fi-he-130-2022.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to ensure the protection of essential health care and home care during the labour battle
fi-he-130-2022.t: Securing essential health care and home care during a labour struggle

fi-he-130-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the legislation on the ban on the keeping of animals
fi-he-130-2026.s: The project will examine the penalties for animal protection offences and assess the possibilities for extending the ban on animal husbandry and improving controls and preparing legislative proposals in this regard.
fi-he-130-2026.t: amending the legislation on the prohibition of animal husbandry

fi-he-131-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act
fi-he-131-2025.s: The draft is part of the implementation of the government programme of the Government of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, which provides for the government's responsible reform of alcohol policy in the European direction and the continuation of the 2018 overall reform of the alcohol law, with the aim of promoting fair and open competition, and the government has agreed to a number of measures in the field of alcohol trade.
fi-he-131-2025.t: Law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act

fi-he-131-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the enforcement of the legislation on the apartment information system
fi-he-131-2026.s: The proposed legislative amendment would allow for the conversion of the bonds held by creditors into electronic owner entries in the property register without the issue of the share certificate to the Land Survey, thus speeding up the transition to the electronic system and bringing cost savings.
fi-he-131-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the enforcement of the legislation on the apartment information system

fi-he-132-2026.f: Draft legislation on the winding-up and delegation of duties of the Labour Council and the Cooperation Ombudsman to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-132-2026.s: Report by the Working Party on the Dissolution of the Working Council on savings and needs to improve the functioning of the labour market.
fi-he-132-2026.t: Legislative framework for the closure and delegation of tasks of the Labour Council and the Office of the Cooperation Ombudsman

fi-he-133-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the implementation and control of certain obligations under the Regulation of the Parliament of Finland and of the Council on critical raw materials and related laws
fi-he-133-2026.s: The project will prepare the main national provisions required by Regulation (EU) 1252/2024 on critical raw materials in the EU, which will prepare a new law on the implementation, control and sanctions of certain obligations of the Regulation on critical raw materials in the EU, as well as amendments to certain other laws.
fi-he-133-2026.t: on the implementation and control of certain obligations under the Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on critical raw materials and on related laws

fi-he-134-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 46a of the Law on the Supervision of Labour Protection and the Cooperation on Health Protection at Work, section 76 of the Act on the Activities and Financing of the Institute of Occupational Health and on the Processing of Personal Data in Social and Health Care
fi-he-134-2026.s: The proposal amends the regulation on the obligation for doctors to report occupational diseases and other work-related diseases.
fi-he-134-2026.t: Amendment of section 46a of the Law on the Supervision of Labour Protection and the Cooperation on Health Protection at Work, section 76 of the Act on the Activities and Financing of the Institute of Occupational Health and on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care

fi-he-135-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 3 and 283 of the Real Estate Act and section 76 of the Private Road Act
fi-he-135-2026.s: Support for the basic improvement of the land register of the Land Surveying Institute as the administrator of the Real Estate Register by reviewing the legislation on the procedure for the provision of the Real Estate Act and the Private Road Act.
fi-he-135-2026.t: Act amending sections 3 and 283 of the Real Estate Act and section 76 of the Private Road Act

fi-he-136-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending section 1 of the Law on the supervision of ship safety and the execution of the fine
fi-he-136-2026.s: The aim of the project is to adopt a new law on ship safety control and to implement the ship safety regulation of the maritime transport package, the so-called Flag State Directive and the Port State Inspection Directive.
fi-he-136-2026.t: Amendment of section 1 of the Law on the Control of Ship Safety and the Enforcement of the fine

fi-he-137-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the Government
fi-he-137-2025.t: Act amending the Law on the Government

fi-he-137-2026.f: Government proposal to amend the legislation on penalties for loss to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-137-2026.s: The project implements the decriminalisation record of the government programme and implements the so-called EU Condition Directive (2024/1260) at national level.
fi-he-137-2026.t: Amendment of the legislation on penalties for loss

fi-he-138-2022.f: Government proposal to amend the Cross-Border Health Care Act
fi-he-138-2022.s: In addition, taking into account the obligations of the patient directive (2011 / 24 / EU), the impact of the amendments to the Health Insurance Act on the reimbursement process for medical expenses incurred abroad and the need for change in implementation, will be assessed.
fi-he-138-2022.t: amending the Law on Cross-Border Health Care

fi-he-138-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 2 of the Act on the financing of state research and development activities 2024-2030
fi-he-138-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 2 of the Law on the financing of state research and development activities from 2024 to 2030
fi-he-138-2025.t: Act amending section 2 of the Law on State funding for R & D in the period 2024-2030

fi-he-138-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Pre-litigation, the Law on Criminal Matters and certain other laws
fi-he-138-2026.s: The project would cover measures other than the negotiation of charges and the reform of the leniency procedure. The preparation of the extension of the scope of the proceedings will be carried out by the Working Party set up in autumn 2023 and the preparation of the overall assessment of the fine procedure by the Working Group set up in autumn 2024.
fi-he-138-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Pre-litigation, the Law on Criminal Matters and certain other laws

fi-he-139-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 5 and 7 of the Act on the Safety Information Report
fi-he-139-2026.s: The legislative project prepares the necessary amendments to the Act on Safety Information (466/2012), which is the basis for the introduction of the Cell Broadcast Warning System, and other necessary amendments to the Act on the Safety Notice. The Board of Directors' proposal is to be submitted to the Parliament of Finland during the spring session of 2026.
fi-he-139-2026.t: Act amending sections 5 and 7 of the Dangerous Information Act

fi-he-14-2026.f: Government proposal for legislation on emergency detention and on changing the procedure for the release of prisoners in prison
fi-he-14-2026.s: In February 2026, the Government has submitted a proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on emergency detention and the modification of the procedure for the release of life prisoners, in order to ensure that the most dangerous prisoners are not released, in accordance with the government programme.
fi-he-14-2026.t: Legislative changes to the security and release procedure for life prisoners

fi-he-140-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on criminal intelligence of the Border Guard
fi-he-140-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare the main provisions on criminal intelligence of the Border Guard, thereby improving the ability of the Border Guard to better inform the Border Guard about internal security threats associated with the tasks of the Border Guard.
fi-he-140-2026.t: Legal framework for border guard criminal intelligence

fi-he-141-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 21 of the Tax Procedure Act
fi-he-141-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 21 of the Tax Procedure Act
fi-he-141-2025.t: Amendment of section 21 of the Tax Code

fi-he-141-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Vehicle Act and related laws
fi-he-141-2026.s: The project will make the legislative changes required for the national implementation of the EU Regulation on NRMM and EURO 7, including smaller legislative changes for national vehicles, such as changes in support of the implementation of the State Productivity Programme or technical updating needs.
fi-he-141-2026.t: Act amending the vehicle law and related laws

fi-he-142-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on Authorised Industrial Ombudsmen
fi-he-142-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend the procedure for applying for and granting authorisation under the Law on Authorised Industrial Ombudsmen, with a view to abolishing the authorisation of temporary agents, and to change the authorisation to remain in force for an indefinite period of time.
fi-he-142-2026.t: amending the Act on Authorised Industrial Ombudsmen

fi-he-143-2026.f: Government proposal for approval and entry into force of an agreement with Sweden on the final disposal of spent fuel and radioactive waste resulting from research activities transferred to the Parliament of Finland for research purposes
fi-he-143-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland approve the agreement between Finland and Sweden on the disposal of spent fuel and radioactive waste resulting from its research activities in Sweden and the enforcement of the provisions of the agreement in the field of legislation.
fi-he-143-2026.t: on the acceptance and entry into force of an agreement with Sweden on the disposal of spent fuel and radioactive waste resulting from research activities carried out for research purposes in the territory of the Kingdom of Sweden

fi-he-144-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on mixed insurance for unemployment benefits
fi-he-144-2026.s: According to section 4.3 of the Government Programme of Prime Minister Orpo, Social Security for Incentive Work, combined insurance for unemployment benefits would improve social security for both employees and entrepreneurs. In preparation, account will be taken of family and family carers and unemployment cover in the cultural and creative sectors, in accordance with section 5.4 of the Government Programme.
fi-he-144-2026.t: Legislation on combined insurance for unemployment benefits

fi-he-145-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Tobacco Act
fi-he-145-2026.s: reform the regulation on tobacco smoke problems in housing companies and other communities, and make other necessary changes to the tobacco law;

fi-he-146-2026.f: Draft legislation and other laws extending the principle of the last pension institution of the occupational pension scheme to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-146-2026.s: The purpose of the project is to extend the procedure of the last pension institution in the occupational pension scheme (the "Vilma procedure ') to cover the pension provision of persons covered by the Bank of Finland and the Financial Supervisory Authority and the pension provision of persons insured under the Åland Act on Public Sector Pensions.
fi-he-146-2026.t: Legislation to extend the principle of the last pension institution in the occupational pension scheme and other laws

fi-he-147-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of the Agreement on social security with the Eastern Republic of Uruguay
fi-he-147-2026.s: The project prepares a proposal from the government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and implementation of the agreement on social security with Uruguay.
fi-he-147-2026.t: Adoption and entry into force of the Agreement on social security with the Eastern Republic of Uruguay

fi-he-148-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 7 of the Act on temporary measures to combat the use of means of entry
fi-he-148-2026.s: The project is designed to prepare a government proposal for interim measures to extend the law on the fight against the instrumented entry.
fi-he-148-2026.t: Amendment of section 7 of the Law on temporary measures to combat the use of means of entry

fi-he-149-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Export of Military Equipment
fi-he-149-2026.s: The project is preparing a proposal for a government proposal to amend the Law on the Export of Military Equipment (282/2012) which entered into force on 30 June 2012. It provides for the supervision and control of the export, transfer, brokering and transit of military equipment.
fi-he-149-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Export of Military Equipment

fi-he-150-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the municipal law
fi-he-150-2026.s: The draft law would introduce a provision in the Municipal Act that the Ministry of Finance would be responsible for the general direction and monitoring of the municipalities' preparation to the extent that it was not within the remit of the other Ministry. In addition, some other clarifications would be made in the Municipal Act.
fi-he-150-2026.t: Act amending the Local Government Act

fi-he-151-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 119 and 124 of the Income Tax Act and sections 7 and 15 of the Tax Act on Income Tax Limited
fi-he-151-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending sections 119 and 124 of the Income Tax Act; Act limited to sections 7 and 15 of the Income Tax Act
fi-he-151-2026.t: amending sections 119 and 124 of the Income Tax Act and sections 7 and 15 of the Income Tax Act to a limited extent

fi-he-152-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the church law
fi-he-152-2026.s: In November 2016, when the meeting of the church assembly decided to discuss Act 1/2016 on the development of the parish election procedures and the proposal of the Diocese Council to postpone the date of the parish election 3/2016 and to send the representative initiative and the diocese council proposal to the church government for preparation. Some of the proposed changes were implemented now.
fi-he-152-2026.t: The law of changing the church law

fi-he-153-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of an agreement on air transport with the Federative Republic of Brazil
fi-he-153-2026.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the exercise of their traffic.
fi-he-153-2026.t: Approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Federative Republic of Brazil

fi-he-154-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the State Budget and related laws
fi-he-154-2024.t: Act amending the Law on the State Budget and related laws

fi-he-154-2025.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the exercise of their traffic.

fi-he-154-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for the approval and entry into force of the Agreement on Air Transport with the Republic of Peru
fi-he-154-2026.s: The agreement is a bilateral air transport agreement which, inter alia, provides for the possibility and conditions under which the parties may designate airlines to exercise the traffic rights conferred by the agreement, which provides for the rights and obligations of airlines in the course of their activities.

fi-he-155-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Act on the Energy Certificate of the Building and the Construction Act

fi-he-156-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on Housing Rights

The Forest Aid Amendment Act is to enter into force from the beginning of 2027 and the application of the aid application would be opened in the forest centre from the end of March 2027.

fi-he-199-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a Act amending the Health Care Act and the Act on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care

fi-he-207-2026.s: The proposed legislative changes aim to streamline the State's compensation activities and to clarify the information rights of the State Treasury and some of its partners, and to clarify the role of the State Treasury as representative of the State in the damages cases in which the State is a party.

fi-he-209-2026.t: Act amending sections 10 and 20a of the Income Tax Act and related laws

fi-he-210-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care
fi-he-210-2024.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of social and health care

fi-he-213-2026.t: Act amending the compulsory education law and related laws

fi-he-214-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Forest Act
fi-he-214-2026.s: The task of the working group is to prepare the amendments to the Forest Act and the Government Regulation on the Sustainable Management and Use of Forests, the aim of which is to prepare a draft government proposal and a draft amendment to the Government Regulation on the Sustainable Management and Use of Forests.

fi-he-215-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on water management information reserve and related laws
fi-he-215-2026.s: The project aims to introduce a new law on water resources. The current legal basis for data on water management is incomplete and does not take into account, for example, the requirements for the protection of personal data.
fi-he-215-2026.t: Law on the aquatic information reserve and related laws

fi-he-216-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Foreign Law and certain other laws
fi-he-216-2026.s: The project will implement legislative changes to the residence permit for growth entrepreneurs and entrepreneurs.
fi-he-216-2026.t: amending the Foreign Law and certain other laws

fi-he-217-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a regulation supplementing the Regulation of the Parliament of Finland and of the Council on the European Health Information Area
fi-he-217-2026.s: To introduce the necessary amendments to the Act on the processing of social and healthcare customer information (703/2023, the Customer Information Act) and related other laws to implement the Regulation on the European Health Information Area (EHIS), while making certain other necessary changes to those laws.
fi-he-217-2026.t: Regulation supplementing the Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the European Health Information Area

fi-he-218-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to regulate the secondary use and sanctions of health data in the European Health Information Area Regulation
fi-he-218-2026.s: It proposes to introduce a new law supplementing the secondary use of electronic health data in the European Parliament and Council Regulation (EHDS) on the European Health Information Area in order to implement the amendments to national legislation resulting from the implementation of the Regulation and to introduce a penalty regulation.
fi-he-218-2026.t: Regulation supplementing the European Health Information Area Regulation on secondary use and penalties for health information

fi-he-219-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the distribution of opioid overdose antidrugs and for a law amending the pharmaceutical law
fi-he-219-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act on the distribution of opioid overdose antidrugs; Act amending the Pharmaceutical Act
fi-he-219-2026.t: Act on the distribution of opioid overdose antidrugs and on the modification of the pharmaceutical law

fi-he-220-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland on the conformity of technical equipment intended for use as a law at work and amending certain related laws
fi-he-220-2026.s: In the case of machinery intended for use at work, the proposal would essentially implement the new EU machinery regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which requires legislation at national level, and aim at clarifying and updating the regulatory framework for technical equipment used at work.
fi-he-220-2026.t: on the conformity of technical equipment intended for use as a law at work and amending certain related laws

fi-he-221-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Tobacco Act
fi-he-221-2024.s: The purpose of the tobacco law is to provide for sales, characteristics, packaging, etc.

fi-he-221-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the formation of certain State-owned areas as Preservation Areas
fi-he-221-2026.s: The project proposes to amend the two laws on the formation of certain state-owned areas as protected areas, which have established 130 protected areas under the 1923 Nature Conservation Act.
fi-he-221-2026.t: Amendment of the Act on the formation of certain State-owned areas as Preservation Areas

fi-he-222-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 17 of the Act on the Law on Trustees
fi-he-222-2026.s: To promote electronic access to the lobbyist and the representative representative, and to assess further possibilities for easing the impediment regulation of the trustee and the need for the guardian's permission in certain situations of renunciation, based on a previous government proposal (HE 69/2025 vp).
fi-he-222-2026.t: Amendment of section 17 of the Act on the Enforcement of Interests

fi-he-223-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the regulation on the scope of criminal law in Finland
fi-he-223-2026.s: The provisions of Chapter 1 on the territorial scope of criminal law are being reformed.
fi-he-223-2026.t: amending the scope of Finnish criminal law

fi-he-224-2026.f: Draft laws of the Board of Directors amending the Act on Election Financing
fi-he-224-2026.s: The motion proposes to amend the Election and Election Financing Act. The Election Act proposes changes in preparation for disturbances and changes in the appearance of voting tickets. The Election Finance Act proposes to extend the penalty payment procedure in the supervision.
fi-he-224-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Election Financing

fi-he-225-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a Law on the Temporary Amendment of section 14 of the Lover Act and the Amendment of section 28 of the Gambling Act
fi-he-225-2026.s: The purpose of the legislative project is to prepare amendments to the lottery laws (1047/2001) and to the Gambling Act (10/2026) as regards the redemption of the money-fast-draw profit.
fi-he-225-2026.t: Temporary amendment of section 14 of the Lover Act and amendment of section 28 of the Gambling Act

fi-he-226-2026.f: Draft amending budget 2026 of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-226-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Draft amending budget 2026 III

fi-he-227-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on taxation of business income
fi-he-227-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Act on taxation of business income
fi-he-227-2026.t: Act amending the Act on taxation of business income

fi-he-228-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending the Act on Social Assistance and repealing section 29 of the Act on the State Contribution of the Local Government to Basic Services
fi-he-228-2026.s: The Act on Income Support would be amended to allow the Social Insurance Institution to charge the municipality's contribution to the basic income allowance on a monthly basis. The reduction of the contribution would no longer be made for the municipality's basic services with a delay of two years. section 29 of the Act on State aid for basic services would be repealed.
fi-he-228-2026.t: Amendment of the Act on Social Assistance and repealing section 29 of the Act on the State Contribution to Basic Services of the Municipality

fi-he-229-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 2 of the Act on the financing of state research and development activities 2024-2030
fi-he-229-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 2 of the Law on the financing of state research and development activities from 2024 to 2030
fi-he-229-2026.t: Act amending section 2 of the Law on State funding for R & D in the period 2024-2030

fi-he-230-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the Supply Information Reserve and related laws
fi-he-230-2026.s: The project aims to implement a national public procurement information reserve covering public sector-wide public sector information on public procurement and purchases throughout the life cycle in a combined and comparable form, and to prepare the necessary legislative changes under the direction of the Ministry of Finance.
fi-he-230-2026.t: Act on the Supply Information Reserve and related laws

fi-he-231-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 6 of the State Pension Fund Act
fi-he-231-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the amount transferred from the Fund to the State budget in 2027 should be 67.5%, which would be 49.5% of the State's pension expenditure between 2028 and 2037, and that the amount transferred from 2038 onwards would be permanently 48% of the State's pension expenditure.
fi-he-231-2026.t: Amendment of section 6 of the State Pension Fund Act

fi-he-232-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation on criminal intelligence in Customs
fi-he-232-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend the law on criminal offences in Customs by creating criminal intelligence provisions for Customs which would allow the use of means of obtaining information at an earlier stage on a risk-based basis.

fi-he-233-2026.f: Government proposal for legislation on the organisation of early childhood education, basic education and free education in the Parliament of Finland in case of disruption
fi-he-233-2026.s: The proposal introduces provisions in the ECEC, the Basic Education Act, the Helsinki European School Act and the Free Cultural Work Act aimed at ensuring that legal activities continue as smoothly as possible in the event of disruption.
fi-he-233-2026.t: Legislation on the organisation of early childhood education, basic education and free education in case of disruption

fi-he-234-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend Chapter 3 and Chapter 8 of the Church Act and section 74 of the Orthodox Church Act
fi-he-234-2026.s: The project is intended to prepare amendments to the Act on the Law of the Church and the Act on Orthodox Church relating to the law on the shareholders' register of the estate.
fi-he-234-2026.t: Act amending Chapter 3 and Chapter 8 of the Church Act and section 74 of the Orthodox Act

fi-he-235-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending section 13 of the Act on National Literature, Education and Qualifications Registers, section 13 of the Law on Language Skills for General Government Staff and section 9 of the Act on the National Skills Information Reserve
fi-he-235-2026.s: The project implements the changes to the continental law, the need for which has arisen in the preparation of the accession of Åland to the national study and qualification registers, while taking into account the needs of the recent legislative changes and other data protection needs identified.
fi-he-235-2026.t: amending the Act on National Literature, Education and Qualifications, section 13 of the Law on Language Skills for General Government Staff and section 9 of the Act on the National Skills Information Reserve

fi-he-236-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the supervision and enforcement of the obligations of the EU Forest Destruction Regulation and related laws
fi-he-236-2026.s: The proposal is linked to the complementary national regulation required by EU Forest Destruction Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, which is the preparation of a new Forest Destruction Act, which would in particular provide for the imposition of a competent authority and its details of competence and for sanctions against the EU Forest Destruction Regulation.
fi-he-236-2026.t: Law on the supervision and enforcement of obligations under the EU Forest Destruction Regulation and related laws

fi-he-237-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending the Business Register Act, section 15 of the Business and Community Information Act and section 6 of the Patent and Registration Act
fi-he-237-2026.s: The project is preparing a proposal from the Board of Directors to implement the Second Directive on the digitisation of company law.
fi-he-237-2026.t: amending Articles 15 of the Business Registration Act, 15 of the Business and Community Information Act and 6 of the Patent and Registration Act

fi-he-238-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on certain periods of limitation and action under employment law
fi-he-238-2026.s: The project will assess questions relating to the time of action for working time plugins and, where appropriate, annual leave claims.
fi-he-238-2026.t: Legislation on certain periods of limitation and action in the field of labour law

fi-he-239-2026.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of amendments to the legislation on certain tasks of the Centre for Employment, Development and Administration
fi-he-239-2026.s: The project prepares a government proposal to implement legislative changes related to some of the tasks of the RUGA, which is the result of a study carried out by the Ministry as an official, which has assessed the roles of the RUKA and the local employment services in particular and the division of tasks in promoting employment and recruitment.
fi-he-239-2026.t: Amendment of legislation on certain tasks of the Employment, Development and Management Centre

fi-he-240-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend sections 11 and 23 of the Act on the emissions trading of fossil fuels and section 2 of the Act on sustainability criteria for certain fuels
fi-he-240-2026.s: It proposes to amend the Act on emissions trading in the distribution of fossil fuels and the Act on Sustainability.
fi-he-240-2026.t: Amendment of sections 11 and 23 of the Fossil Fuel Distribution Act and of section 2 of the Act on Sustainability Criteria for Certain Fuels

fi-he-241-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 65 of the Law on the implementation of the reform of social care and rescue services and the implementation of the relevant legislation
fi-he-241-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 65 of the Law on the implementation of the reform of the social, health and rescue services sector and the implementation of the relevant legislation
fi-he-241-2026.t: Amendment of section 65 of the Law on the implementation of the reform of the social, health and rescue services sector and the enforcement of the relevant legislation

fi-he-242-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the pharmaceutical law and related laws
fi-he-242-2026.s: The aim is to implement the records of Prime Minister Orpo's government programme on the provision and reception of international assistance for medicines and, among other things, to update hospital-pharmacy regulations in line with the welfare system.
fi-he-242-2026.t: Act amending the Medical Act and related laws

fi-he-243-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on legislation to harmonise pharmaceutical assessment activities
fi-he-243-2026.s: The project will continue to develop long-term pharmaceutical issues, with the aim of implementing Prime Minister Orpo's government programme record on the reform of the evaluation processes and criteria for the introduction of medicinal products for outpatient and inpatient care, with a view to ensuring that they are consistent regardless of the mode of administration of the medicine.
fi-he-243-2026.t: Legislation on the harmonisation of pharmaceutical assessment activities

fi-he-244-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as laws amending the Agricultural Self-employed Pension Act and certain other laws
fi-he-244-2026.s: The aim is to amend the Act on the Pensions of the Self-employed and the Act on the Accident and Occupational Diseases of the Self-employed by the Farmers' Insurance Institution, as well as the grant holders of scientific research or artistic activities, who are entitled to a grant for the purposes of pension and accident protection.
fi-he-244-2026.t: Act amending the Agricultural Self-employed Pension Act and certain other laws

fi-he-245-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland as a law amending section 2 of the Self-employed Pension Act and the Pension Security Centre Act
fi-he-245-2026.s: The laws on the pension of the entrepreneur would be amended so that in future the entrepreneur could choose whether to base his pension contributions either on the current pension institution's estimate or on the taxable earnings of the business. The lower limit of the insurance obligation would be maintained at the present time and will continue to be based on the pension institution's assessment.
fi-he-245-2026.t: Act amending section 2 of the Self-employed Pension Act and the Pension Security Centre Act

fi-he-246-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care
fi-he-246-2026.s: The presentation proposes to amend the Social and Health Care Act, which would identify the tasks in which DigiFinland Oy could continue to act as a joint stakeholder in welfare areas and the state.
fi-he-246-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of social and health care

fi-he-247-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on access and related laws imposed by the Court
fi-he-247-2026.s: Enabling the application for a restraining order against a person causing repeated threats or disturbances to businesses.
fi-he-247-2026.t: Act on the Court's refusal of access and related laws

fi-he-248-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on the State Budget and related laws
fi-he-248-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend the Law on the State Budget, the Law on the Treasury, the Act on the National Centre for Financial and Human Resources, the Act on Government Enterprises and the Law on the Forest Administration.
fi-he-248-2026.t: Act amending the Law on the State Budget and related laws

fi-he-249-2026.f: The Board of Directors' proposal for a tax credit for clean industry investments to be granted to the Parliament of Finland in 2027 and 2028 and amending section 3 of the Act on Innovation Financing Centre Business Finland and Business Finland
fi-he-249-2026.s: It is proposed to provide for a tax credit for investment provided for by the new State aid framework for the transition of the EU clean industry, following the tax credit provided for by the Law on the Tax Credit for some large investments in the climate-neutral economy (148/2025), which entered into force in the spring of 2025.
fi-he-249-2026.t: on the tax credit for investments in clean industry for 2027 and 2028 and amending section 3 of the Act on Innovation Finance Centre Business Finland and Business Finland

fi-he-250-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for reform of credit institutions' legislation
fi-he-250-2026.s: The project will bring into force the reform of EU credit institution legislation in Finland, and will also modernise and update national credit institution legislation.

fi-he-251-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend and temporarily amend the Tax Accounting Act and to amend and amend the Income Tax Act
fi-he-251-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending and temporarily amending the Tax Accounting Act; Act amending and temporarily amending the Income Tax Act
fi-he-251-2026.t: amending and temporarily amending the Tax Accounting Act and the Income Tax Act

fi-he-252-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the Customer Information System for Business Services
fi-he-252-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the Articles of the Act on the Customer Information System for Business Services be amended and repealed in part, which provide for certain reporting obligations for financial services. The purpose of the information is to be extended to the licence and to the Finnfund Oy is added to the business service providers.
fi-he-252-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Customer Information System for Business Services

fi-he-253-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 37a of the Act on guarantees of origin for energy and the Law on sustainability criteria for certain fuels
fi-he-253-2026.s: Implement amendments to the Regulation on guarantees of origin of the Renewable Energy Directive (RED III).
fi-he-253-2026.t: Amendment of section 37a of the Act on guarantees of origin for energy and of the Act on sustainability criteria for certain fuels

fi-he-254-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Cooperative Act
fi-he-254-2026.s: The task of the working group is to implement the changes to the administrative representation of staff decided by the government at the mid-term meeting in the spring of 2025, to prepare its report in the form of a proposal from the Board, to be submitted to the Ministry for further preparation.

fi-he-255-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law to safeguard the secrecy of defence inventions
fi-he-255-2026.s: The law on inventions relevant to national defence (551/1967) contains provisions on the patenting of inventions which are relevant to national defence. The needs for amendment of the law have been assessed in the context of the overall reform of the patent law.
fi-he-255-2026.t: As a law to safeguard the secrecy of defence inventions

fi-he-256-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland on the use of substances of human origin intended for use in human beings and related laws
fi-he-256-2026.s: Regulation (EU) 2024/1938 of the European Parliament and of the Council on quality and safety requirements for human substances intended for human consumption and repealing Directives 2002 / 98 / EC and 2004 / 23 / EC ("the Soho Regulation ') entered into force on 7 August 2024 and its application starts on 7 August 2027.
fi-he-256-2026.t: on the use of substances of human origin intended for use in human beings and related laws

fi-he-257-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Waste Act
fi-he-257-2026.s: The project is preparing amendments to the Waste Act (646/2011) to increase recycling and control of incineration in order to meet EU obligations, for example.
fi-he-257-2026.t: Act on the amendment of the Waste Act

fi-he-258-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the equipping of buildings with charging points and charging points for electric vehicles and with automation and control systems
fi-he-258-2026.s: The project amends the legislation on charging points for electric buildings, which is adapted to the requirements of the recast Directive on the energy efficiency of buildings.
fi-he-258-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the equipping of buildings with electrical vehicle charging points and charging point capabilities and automation and control systems

fi-he-259-2026.s: The project aims to prepare legislative changes to facilitate the status of overindebted enforcement debtors.
fi-he-259-2026.t: Facilitating the position of over-indebted debtors in enforcement

fi-he-260-2020.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption of Council Decision (EU, Euratom) 2020/2053 on the system of the European Union's own resources
fi-he-260-2020.s: Legislative proposals: Council Decision (EU, Euratom) 2020/2053 on the system of own resources of the European Union and repealing Decision 2014 / 335 / EU, Euratom
fi-he-260-2020.t: adopting Council Decision (EU, Euratom) 2020/2053 on the system of the European Union's own resources

fi-he-260-2026.s: The proposal proposes to amend the car-fixing law so as to strengthen the vehicle-fixing system in addition to vehicles registered by the Transport and Communications Agency (Traficom) for vehicles registered by the Aland vehicle authority, and to clarify the powers of the authorities, appeal and time for processing applications.
fi-he-260-2026.t: Act amending the Car Restraint Act
