fi-he-261-2026.s: Due to its high speed of adjustment, hydro power is a significant reserve source to balance the differences between consumption and production in different situations of the electricity system, the project is designed to allow for a derogation from the permit requirements for regulating the hydroelectric power plant, if necessary to balance the electricity system.
fi-he-261-2026.t: Temporary derogation from the permit provisions of the hydroelectric power plant to balance the electricity system

fi-he-262-2026.s: Review the timeliness of the monetary regulation of the minimum daily penalty.
fi-he-262-2026.t: Review of the amount of the minimum daily fine

fi-he-263-2026.s: On 5 April 2023, the European Commission presented a proposal for a Regulation on the transfer of criminal proceedings (COM (2023) 185 final), which aims to allow the transfer of criminal proceedings between Member States in order to investigate or prosecute a crime in the best-suited Member State.
fi-he-263-2026.t: Transfer of criminal proceedings (national legislation supplementing the EU Regulation)

fi-he-264-2026.s: In the second phase of the project, civil intelligence legislation will be reviewed in relation to intelligence powers to meet the requirements of a changed security and cyber environment.
fi-he-264-2026.t: Legislative project to revise Chapter 7 of the Civil Intelligence Act and the Police Personal Data Act, phase 2

fi-he-265-2026.s: The main objective of the project is to protect society and individuals from serious and organised crime by enhancing the exchange of information on organised crime and the administrative fight against organised crime, the task of which is to prepare key provisions for this set of issues.
fi-he-265-2026.t: Legislative project on legislation to combat organised crime and related legislation

fi-he-266-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 98a of the Act on Excise Tax on Liquid Fuels and the Excise Tax Act
fi-he-266-2026.t: Act amending section 99a of the Act on Excise Tax on Liquid Fuels and the Excise Tax Act

fi-he-267-2026.f: Government bill amending the Act on the Pension Fund of the Evangelis Lutheran Church
fi-he-267-2026.s: The proposal to amend the regulation on the management of the pension fund of the Evangelis Lutheran Church. The church government would no longer be the board of the pension fund, but the church assembly would elect a board of directors for the pension fund. The Board would appoint the head of the pension fund.
fi-he-267-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the Pension Fund of the Evangelis-Lutheran Church

fi-he-268-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation to amend the SORA provisions
fi-he-268-2026.s: The aim of the proposal is to clarify the provisions on the withdrawal of the right to study and drug testing of the Vocational Education and Training Act, the University Act and the Polytechnic Law, based on the development needs identified in the final report of the Socrates project, as set out by the Ministry of Education and Culture.
fi-he-268-2026.t: Legislative changes to the provisions of the Sora

fi-he-269-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to implement obligations arising from the International Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) and the EU Working Time Directive on inland waterway transport
fi-he-269-2026.s: The project implements the amendments made to the ILO International Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) guidelines in 2025, including the prevention of violence and harassment on board ships, and assesses the need for change and, if necessary, the changes to national legislation in the following sets: - insurance (rejection cases) required by the MLC and the maritime sector;
fi-he-269-2026.t: implementing obligations under the International Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) and the EU Directive on working time in inland waterway transport

fi-he-270-2026.f: Government proposal to amend the Act on the Control of Certain Artificial Intelligence Systems and to introduce certain other laws (implementation of Phase II of the Artificial Intelligence Regulation)
fi-he-270-2026.s: The Government's proposal would lay down national provisions for the implementation of the provisions of the EU Artificial Intelligence Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) which are to apply from 2 August 2026 (implementation of Phase II of the Artificial Intelligence Regulation).
fi-he-270-2026.t: amending the Act on the supervision of certain artificial intelligence systems and certain other laws (implementation of Phase II of the artificial intelligence regulation)

fi-he-271-2026.f: Government proposal for law on the monitoring of foreign investments and licensing procedures
fi-he-271-2026.s: The Ministry of Employment and the Economy has prepared, in cooperation with the Network of Public Authorities for Cross-Administrative Foreign Purchases (YKA), an evaluation memorandum (5.2.2025) on the need for the renewal of the Law on the Monitoring of Foreign Purchases (172/2012). The working group for the preparation of HE has started work in March 2025.
fi-he-271-2026.t: Law on the monitoring of foreign investment and authorisation procedures

fi-he-272-2026.f: Government proposal for a law amending the Measuring Instruments Act and certain other laws and repealing the Regulation of the Consumer Affairs Council
fi-he-272-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the negotiation committees provided for in the measuring instruments laws (707/2011) and in certain other laws be abolished.
fi-he-272-2026.t: Repeal of the Regulation amending the Measuring Instruments Act and certain other laws and the Consumer Affairs Council

fi-he-273-2026.f: Government proposal to amend section 3 of the Drugs Act and the Act on Electronic Prescriptions
fi-he-273-2026.t: Act amending section 3 of the Drugs Act and the Act on Electronic Prescriptions

fi-he-274-2026.f: Draft legislation of the Government to the Parliament of Finland amending sections 15 and 20 of the Act on Health Care Professionals, the Law on Social Welfare Professionals and the Act on Authorisation and Control
fi-he-274-2026.s: Under the programme of the Government of Petteri Orpo, the overall reform of social and health professionals' legislation will be carried out as part of the Good Work Programme. The reform will be carried out in a way that links professional rights only to the necessary and proportionate conditions for customer and patient safety.
fi-he-274-2026.t: amending sections 15 and 20 of the Health Care Professionals Act, the Health Care Professionals Act and the Authorisation and Control Agency Act

fi-he-29-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the temporary travel document of the European Union and related laws
fi-he-29-2023.s: The Government's proposal brings into force at national level Council Directive (EU) 2019 / 997, the Directive lays down the conditions and procedural rules under which non-represented citizens can obtain an EU temporary travel document (EU TMA).
fi-he-29-2023.t: Law on the European Union's temporary travel document and related laws

fi-he-299-2022.f: Government bill for social and health care supervision
fi-he-299-2022.s: The proposed new law would bring together provisions on operating conditions for social and health services, ex ante controls, registration, self-control and means of ex post supervision, covering both public service providers and providers and private service providers.
fi-he-299-2022.t: As a law on social and health care supervision

fi-he-3-2025.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Vehicle Act and related laws
fi-he-3-2025.t: Act amending the vehicle law and related laws

fi-he-300-2022.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for legislation on patient and social affairs
fi-he-300-2022.s: The Government's proposal proposes to introduce a new law on patients and social affairs, which would provide for the organisation of the activities of patients' and social affairs, the independence, eligibility and tasks of the patient and social affairs officer, and the processing of personal data.
fi-he-300-2022.t: As a law for patients and social partners

fi-he-305-2022.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care and section 60 of the Health Act and repealing sections 28 and 29 of the Special Health Care Act (functions of the university hospital)
fi-he-305-2022.s: It is proposed to add provisions to the Social and Health Care Act to clarify and strengthen the existing functions and responsibilities of the university hospital in specialised medical services and in the areas of education, research, development and innovation.
fi-he-305-2022.t: As a law amending section 60 of the Act on the Organisation of Social and Health Care and repealing sections 28 and 29 of the Special Health Care Act (functions of a university hospital)

fi-he-316-2022.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Law on Medical Research and to amend certain related laws
fi-he-316-2022.s: It proposes to amend the Law on Medical Research to meet the requirements arising from the reform of the organisation of social and health care, and to amend the Research Act and some related laws on the collection of opinions fees by Regional Ethics Councils.
fi-he-316-2022.t: Act amending the Law on Medical Research and certain other related laws

fi-he-32-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the VAT Act

fi-he-38-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Tobacco Act
fi-he-38-2024.s: The purpose of the tobacco law is to provide for sales, characteristics, packaging, etc.

fi-he-44-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act
fi-he-44-2026.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Alcohol Act
fi-he-44-2026.t: Law on the amendment of the Alcohol Act

fi-he-46-2026.f: Government proposal to amend the provisions of the law on data protection and the processing of personal data in criminal matters and in the context of the maintenance of national security
fi-he-46-2026.s: The project concerns the evaluation of the penalties applicable to breaches of data protection legislation, which provides a memorandum of assessment in preparation for the necessary legislative changes.
fi-he-46-2026.t: amending the provisions of the law on data protection and the processing of personal data in criminal matters and in the context of the maintenance of national security

fi-he-48-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on International Cooperation in the Enforcement of Certain Criminal Sanctions
fi-he-48-2025.s: The project will assess whether legislation should be amended to allow the death penalty sentenced in another country to be converted into the next penalty for freedom for the act in question in Finland.
fi-he-48-2025.t: amending the Act on International Cooperative Action in the Enforcement of Certain Criminal Sanctions

fi-he-49-2026.f: Presentation by the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland of amendments to the legislation on the exchange of information between the Social Insurance Institution of Finland
fi-he-49-2026.s: Under Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government programme, social security abuses are prevented and the exchange of information between Kela and other authorities is promoted as well as Kela's rights to information.
fi-he-49-2026.t: amending the legislation on the exchange of information between public pension institutions

fi-he-5-2026.s: The project explains the scope of the fine and fine law (754/2010), as well as other needs for amendment of the law.

fi-he-50-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 1 of the Act on Electronic Communications Services and the Act on the Enforcement of the fine
fi-he-50-2023.s: The Government's proposal proposes that the authorities in accordance with Chapters 3 and 4 of the EU Data Management Regulation should be entrusted to the Transport and Communications Agency and that the Agency should propose ways of monitoring the Regulation and imposing sanctions.
fi-he-50-2023.t: Act amending section 1 of the Law on the Enforcement of the Law on Electronic Communications Services and the Penal Code

fi-he-50-2025.s: The government is implementing a voluntary return and exit package, which includes, among other things, the abolition of the right of illegal residents to non-urgent social and health services and social security, in other words, the return to the legal situation prior to the last parliamentary term.

fi-he-50-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 10 of the Finnish Constitution
fi-he-50-2026.s: Preparation of the necessary amendments to section 10 of the Constitution, taking into account the needs of criminal, civil and military intelligence and EU law, new forms of serious crime and technological development.
fi-he-50-2026.t: Act amending section 10 of the Finnish Constitution

fi-he-63-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on health services assisting in the detection of child-related suspected offences
fi-he-63-2026.s: Reform of the law on the organisation of the investigation of sexual assault and battery offences against children (1009/2008).
fi-he-63-2026.t: As a law on health services assisting in the detection of child-related suspected offences

fi-he-64-2026.f: Draft legislation on coordination of invalidity pension and earnings in the Parliament of Finland
fi-he-64-2026.s: The aim is to prepare the necessary legislation to reconcile disability pension and earnings at work, which would replace the current provisions on the suspension of disability pension, which are contained in the law in force in force on time on the promotion of the return to work of persons on disability pension (738/2009).
fi-he-64-2026.t: Legislation on the coordination of invalidity pensions and earnings

fi-he-68-2026.f: Draft laws of the Government amending section 7b of the Disability Benefits Act, section 7b of the Social Insurance Act and section 2 of Chapter 10 and Chapter 11 of the Health Insurance Act
fi-he-68-2026.s: The urgent measures to improve access to social and health services in the government programme of Prime Minister Orpo will be reinstated, with emphasis on minors and lower income adults.
fi-he-68-2026.t: amending the Act on Disability Benefits, section 7b of the Act on Social Assistance and section 2 of Chapter 10 and Chapter 11 of the Health Insurance Act

fi-he-69-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on Support for Home and Private Care
fi-he-69-2026.s: The project provides for the Norwegian model of home care support, i.e. a condition for three years' residence in Finland in order to obtain support for home care.
fi-he-69-2026.t: Act amending the Act on Support for Home and Private Care for Children

fi-he-70-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a new law on territorial use and for the amendment of certain related laws
fi-he-70-2026.s: The aim is to modernise the territorial provisions for the implementation of the objectives of the Government Programme of Petteri Orpo. The new Regional Use Act consists of national provisions on territorial objectives, spatial planning and maritime spatial planning (planning of the use of the regions under Chapters 1-10a and 24-26a of the current Regional Use Act).
fi-he-70-2026.t: New territorial laws and laws amending certain related laws

fi-he-71-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend section 17 of the Safety Investigation Act and the Cybersecurity Act
fi-he-71-2026.s: In accordance with the government programme record (p. 178), the possibility of adding safety investigations into serious cyber security incidents to the competence of the Accident Investigation Board will be examined. The Board of Directors will prepare, if necessary, legislative amendments to the Safety Investigation Act and will make any other necessary adjustments.
fi-he-71-2026.t: Act amending section 17 of the Safety Investigation Act and the Cybersecurity Act

fi-he-74-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to facilitate the deployment of very high capacity networks, to amend sections 249 and 303 of the Act on Electronic Communications and to amend section 1 of the Law on the Enforcement of the fine
fi-he-74-2025.s: The project implements at national level the European Union's "Gigabit Infrastructure Act" (Regulation (EU) 2024/1309 of the European Parliament and of the Council on measures to reduce the costs of the deployment of the gigabit electronic communications networks, amending Regulation (EU) 2015/2120 and repealing Directive 2014 / 61 / EU).
fi-he-74-2025.t: Act facilitating the deployment of very high capacity networks, amending sections 249 and 303 of the Act on Electronic Communications Services and amending section 1 of the Law on the execution of the fine

fi-he-77-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the supervision and enforcement of the obligations of the EU Forest Destruction Regulation and related laws
fi-he-77-2025.s: The EU Forest Deforestation Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 was published on 9 June 2023, which aims to minimise the EU's contribution to global deforestation and forest degradation and to reduce the EU's contribution to greenhouse gas emissions and biodiversity loss.
fi-he-77-2025.t: Law on the supervision and enforcement of obligations under the EU Forest Destruction Regulation and related laws

fi-he-79-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending the Act on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals on the basis of research, studies, work placements and voluntary activities
fi-he-79-2026.s: The project implements the government programme on the withdrawal of a student's residence permit if the student relies on income support and on the use of ex post controls to effectively identify the use of income support.
fi-he-79-2026.t: amending the Act on the conditions of entry and residence of third-country nationals on the basis of research, studies, traineeships and voluntary activities

fi-he-81-2023.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending the Waste Act
fi-he-81-2023.t: Act on the amendment of the Waste Act

fi-he-83-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the law on construction
fi-he-83-2026.s: The legislative project is preparing amendments to the Construction Act required by the EU Energy Efficiency Directive (EPBD) and the EU Construction Products Regulation (CPR).
fi-he-83-2026.t: Amendment of the Law on Construction

fi-he-84-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to change the Water Act
fi-he-84-2026.s: The aim is to revise the water law so that the obligation or the fishing levy can be more easily linked to a certified hydroelectric power plant which does not already have one.
fi-he-84-2026.t: Law on the amendment of the Water Act

fi-he-85-2026.f: Draft legislation of the Board of Directors amending the Act on the Evaluation of Information Security of Public Authorities' Information Systems and Communications Systems, the Act on Information Security Assessment Bodies and sections 18 and 48 of the Safety Clearing Act
fi-he-85-2026.s: The aim of the project was to assess the need for updating the legislation on the evaluation of information security in public authorities' information systems and the means to improve the efficiency of the evaluations. On the basis of the final report published by the Project Group on 23 September 2025, a proposal for the amendment of the IT security assessment measures was prepared by the Ministry of Finance.
fi-he-85-2026.t: amending the Act on the Evaluation of Information Systems and Telecommunications Systems of the Authority, the Act on Information Security Assessment Bodies and sections 18 and 48 of the Safety Clearing Act

fi-he-86-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Act on the organisation of social and health care
fi-he-86-2025.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of social and health care

fi-he-88-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to increase Finland's share in the International Monetary Fund and the State Guarantee to the Bank of Finland against any losses arising from the use of the IMF's share in the IMF, as collateral for the NAB facility and as collateral for the loan to the International Monetary Fund
fi-he-88-2026.s: The proposal proposes that the Parliament of Finland give its consent to the Government Council to grant a State guarantee to the Bank of Finland in respect of any losses arising from the use of the International Monetary Fund, as collateral to the NAB and as collateral to the International Monetary Fund.
fi-he-88-2026.t: The increase in the share of Finland in the International Monetary Fund and in the State Guarantee to the Bank of Finland in respect of any losses arising from the use of the International Monetary Fund membership, as collateral for the NAB and as collateral for the loan to the International Monetary Fund

fi-he-90-2026.f: Draft legislation of the Board of Directors on the principles of the social and health care services portfolio
fi-he-90-2026.s: laying down the principles for the inclusion and exclusion of services, methods and forms of work in the range of services in public social and health care; exploring the possibility of providing for a national operator who can make a binding reference to the method of being part of the public service mix;
fi-he-90-2026.t: Legislation on the principles of the social and health services portfolio

fi-he-92-2026.f: Proposal of the Government to the Parliament of Finland for the adoption and entry into force of the enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Kyrgyzstan, of the other part
fi-he-92-2026.s: Adoption and entry into force in Finland of the Agreement on enhanced partnership and cooperation between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Kyrgyzstan, of the other part.
fi-he-92-2026.t: with a view to the adoption and entry into force of the enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Kyrgyzstan, of the other part

fi-he-95-2025.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland amending section 4 of the Act on the taxation of alcohol and alcoholic beverages and the Annex
fi-he-95-2025.s: Legislative proposals: Act amending section 4 of and the Annex to the Act on the taxation of alcoholic beverages and alcoholic beverages
fi-he-95-2025.t: amending section 4 and the Annex of the Act on the taxation of alcohol and alcoholic beverages

fi-he-95-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law on the application of certain European Union provisions on State aid and related laws
fi-he-95-2026.s: The Government's proposal would provide for the recovery of State aid under the EU State aid rules.
fi-he-95-2026.t: Act on the application of certain provisions of the European Union relating to State aid and related laws

fi-he-96-2026.f: Draft laws of the Board of Directors amending section 11 of the Accounting Act, the Business Registration Act and the Audit Act
fi-he-96-2026.s: A project has been established in the Ministry of Employment and the Economy to prepare legislation for the electronic submission of financial statements to the Patent and Registration Board.
fi-he-96-2026.t: Act amending section 11 of the Accounting Act, the Business Registration Act and the Audit Act

fi-he-97-2024.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland to amend the Annex to the Tobacco Tax Act
fi-he-97-2024.t: amending the Annex to the Tobacco Tax Act

fi-he-97-2026.f: Proposal of the Board of Directors to the Parliament of Finland amending section 102 of the Act on the Electronic Prescription of Medicinal Products and the Act on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care
fi-he-97-2026.s: The proposal would implement a set of issues in the third phase of the "Carrier 'medication list, which would include some indications relating to the treatment of the medicinal product in the data content of the Agency, and extend the right of access to the medication list for social care providers and provide for the obligation to join the prescription centre.
fi-he-97-2026.t: amending section 102 of the Act on the Electronic Prescription of Medicinal Products and the Act on the Processing of Customer Data in Social and Health Care

fi-he-98-2026.f: Government proposal to the Parliament of Finland for a law amending Chapters 2 and 10 of the Coercive Act and related laws
fi-he-98-2026.s: The task is to assess the need for amendment of the Coercive Measures Act (806/2011) and to prepare the necessary legislative changes, taking into account also the entries of the Government Programme on the Coercive Measures Act, which may in particular apply to changes in other legislation for reasons of consistency.
fi-he-98-2026.t: Act amending Chapters 2 and 10 of the Coercive Goods Act and related laws

fi-kk-359-2026.f: Written question on the role of port investment in green transition projects and the streamlining of the authorisation process
fi-kk-359-2026.s: In recent years, Finland has promoted the streamlining and prioritisation of green transition projects as part of national climate and industrial policies. Accelerated licensing, proactive cooperation between authorities and prioritisation practices have been targeted in particular at energy and industrial projects such as renewable energy production, the hydrogen economy and low carbon industries.
fi-kk-359-2026.t: on the role of port investment as projects for the green transition and the streamlining of certification

fi-kk-360-2026.f: Written question on oversized farming and control of processed fur
fi-kk-360-2026.s: In accordance with the Animal Welfare Act (693/2023), animal breeding should aim to produce viable, functional and healthy animals, and should not be used for breeding if the breeding combination is likely to cause the offspring diseases or other characteristics that cause significant harm to its well-being.
fi-kk-360-2026.t: Oversized farming and control of processed fur

fi-kk-361-2026.f: Written question on compliance with business-to-business payment conditions
fi-kk-361-2026.s: The law on payment terms for commercial contracts clearly defines the time schedule for the debtor to make payments to the creditor. If the debtor is a trader, the payment period may be exceeded by 30 days only if expressly agreed.

fi-kk-362-2026.f: Written question on the future of local newspapers
fi-kk-362-2026.s: Since the beginning of October, the post office has announced an average increase of 12-13% in the prices of postal services, which is explained by the decrease in paper mail, which increases unit costs and therefore prices.

fi-kk-363-2026.f: Written question on taxation of own use of real estate management services
fi-kk-363-2026.s: The tax on the use of real estate management services is provided for in section 32 of the AVL, which provides that the real estate management service is to be considered as having been used for own use when the owner or owner of the property itself provides a service to the property by his own staff, if the property is used for a remuneration but other than a right to deduct. The owner of the property or the owner of the property or the owner of the property is:
fi-kk-363-2026.t: on taxation of own use of real estate management services

fi-kk-364-2026.f: Written question on the monitoring of the impact of changes in unemployment protection
fi-kk-364-2026.s: The Orpo Government has made significant reductions in unemployment protection, such as the extension of the employment condition and the period of self-responsibility, and the withdrawal of the protection of EUR 300 from the reconciliation of unemployment benefits. In adopting the reductions that entered into force in 2024, the Parliament of Finland also adopted the following statement: "The Council of State requires that the Council of State monitor the effects of changes in unemployment protection, in particular on children.
fi-kk-364-2026.t: Monitoring the impact of changes in unemployment benefits

fi-kk-365-2026.f: Written question on improving patient safety and regulatory tightening of aesthetic treatments
fi-kk-365-2026.s: There is an increasing use of aesthetic treatments and cosmetic surgery, and this is also reflected in the number of complications, the most serious of which are often continued on the public health side.
fi-kk-365-2026.t: Improving patient safety and regulatory tightening of aesthetic treatments

fi-kk-366-2026.f: Written question on civil service transition to military service
fi-kk-366-2026.s: In Finland, there is a very good defence capability and a high-quality military service, measured globally, which is a great honour for many young people. However, the decision between military service and civilian service is made at a young age. The situations of life of young people vary a lot. The reasons for choosing civil service are diverse. In addition to stability, many of the challenges of personal life affect the choice.
fi-kk-366-2026.t: on the transition from civilian to military service

fi-kk-367-2026.f: Written question on the impact of data centres on the adequacy of electricity
fi-kk-367-2026.s: Fortum has concluded a 22-year electricity purchase agreement with Google as part of Google's billion-class data center investments. The positive effects of the giant investment have been ignited, but the impact of the data centre boom on the price, adequacy and security of supply of Finnish electricity is not clear. Finland seems to be based on attracting investment and organising electricity for data centres.
fi-kk-367-2026.t: Effects of data centres on the adequacy of electricity

fi-kk-368-2026.f: Written question on the criteria for the competitive tendering of psychotherapy for demanding medical rehabilitation of Kela and on ensuring the quality of psychotherapy services for children and young people
fi-kk-368-2026.s: On 12 August 2026, Kela published decisions on the competitive tendering of demanding medical rehabilitation for the period from 1 November 2026 to 31 December 2028. In the competition, the comparison between offers meeting the minimum requirements of the invitation to tender was based solely on price, and training beyond the minimum requirements, such as psychotherapy, therapy, work experience or specialist skills, was not considered to be of a sufficient nature.
fi-kk-368-2026.t: on the criteria for tendering for psychotherapy for demanding medical rehabilitation and on ensuring the quality of psychotherapy services for children and young people

fi-kk-369-2026.f: Written question on the possibility of receiving social security for people suffering from ME / CFS
fi-kk-369-2026.s: In 2022, it was estimated that around 10 000 Finns suffer from ME / CFS (myalgic encephalomyelitis), previously referred to as a chronic fatigue syndrome. The disease may significantly impair the patient's ability to function and work. Although there has been a Good Practice Recommendation for the disease since 2021, there are still situations where this disease and its symptoms are not identified.
fi-kk-369-2026.t: on access to social security for people suffering from ME / CFS

fi-kk-370-2026.f: Written question on the impact of Google's billion-class data centre investments on electricity prices and adequacy
fi-kk-370-2026.s: Google has announced its investment in Finland between 2027 and 2028 as much as EUR 13 billion. This is one of the largest individual investments in Finland's history, which has significant positive effects on construction, employment, the economy and Finland's position as an operating environment for digital infrastructure and artificial intelligence.
fi-kk-370-2026.t: The impact of Google's billion-class data center investments on electricity prices and adequacy

fi-kk-371-2026.f: Written question on the affordability of electricity transmission charges
fi-kk-371-2026.s: In recent years, many electricity distribution companies have increased their transmission prices, and the question arises as to whether the profitability of electricity distribution is so poor that additional funding is needed.
fi-kk-371-2026.t: on the reduction of electricity transmission charges

fi-kk-372-2026.f: Written question on self-financing conditions for STEA grants
fi-kk-372-2026.s: Under the Law on the financing of social and health organisations, state aid can be granted to a large extent to promote social well-being and health, which should support equality, equality and the realisation of fundamental rights, but the amount for the STEA grants will decrease from approximately EUR 383.6 million in 2024 to approximately EUR 190 million in 2027.
fi-kk-372-2026.t: on self-financing conditions for STEA grants

fi-kk-373-2026.f: Written question on the environmental impact of data centres
fi-kk-373-2026.s: Finland is an attractive destination for data centres with low-cost and low-emission electricity and cool climate. On Wednesday 9 September, significant news came when Google told us that he would invest EUR 13 billion in Finland. However, there are also question marks in the positive economic news. Many citizens are concerned about the environmental impact of data centres.

fi-kk-374-2026.f: Written question on the strengthening of measures to control African swine fever, the dismantling of legal barriers and the safeguarding of preparedness capacity
fi-kk-374-2026.s: African swine fever (ASF) was found in Finland for the first time in wild boar at the end of July 2026. The disease is deadly for porcine animals and is currently not vaccinated. Although the disease does not infect humans, its spread to pig farms would be an economic disaster for the whole of Finnish food production and food exports.
fi-kk-374-2026.t: on the stepping up of measures to control African swine fever, the dismantling of legal barriers and the safeguarding of preparedness capacity

fi-kk-375-2026.f: Written question on the allocation of fellings to restoration areas
fi-kk-375-2026.s: In Finland, the prevention and conversion of natural depopulation for the recovery of nature requires both protection and restoration of nature. An important target for restoration is Finnish salinity.
fi-kk-375-2026.t: on the allocation of fellings to restoration areas

fi-kk-376-2026.f: Written question on the effects of African swine fever on hunting and the forest industry
fi-kk-376-2026.s: The possible spread of African swine fever from its current prevalence may lead to restrictions on hunting and natural movement, and wider restrictions may also have an impact on hunting and the operating conditions of the forest industry.
fi-kk-376-2026.t: on the impact of the spread of African swine fever on hunting and the forest industry

fi-kk-377-2026.f: Written question on legislation to ensure the inclusion, well-being and exclusion of older people
fi-kk-377-2026.s: The Finnish Youth Act obliges young people to promote their growth, independence and active citizenship, and to consult young people in decision-making concerning them. The law is necessary and its objectives must be supported.
fi-kk-377-2026.t: Legislation to ensure the inclusion, well-being and exclusion of older people

fi-kk-378-2026.f: Written question on the right of parents to care for the health of their children over 12 years of age
fi-kk-378-2026.s: section 4 of the Child Maintenance and Access Act (361/1983) obliges the guardian to care for the care, education and well-being of the child, while sections 7 and 9 of the Act on the Status and Rights of the Patient (785/1992) emphasise the right of the minor to self-determination in accordance with this age and level of development.
fi-kk-378-2026.t: The right of parents to care for the health of their children over 12 years of age

fi-kk-379-2026.f: Written question on the recovery of income support from the debtor
fi-kk-379-2026.s: The Social Insurance Institution or the Welfare Region may at the same time provide that, when deciding on the granting of income support, the income support or part thereof is to be recovered from the debtor if he or she has deliberately failed to meet his maintenance obligations. In such cases, recovery of the income support shall be subject to an application to the administrative court.
fi-kk-379-2026.t: Recovery of the subsistence aid from the debtor

fi-kk-380-2026.f: Written question on the strengthening of the grid in Eastern Finland
fi-kk-380-2026.s: The government has repeatedly stressed that the capacity of the electricity grid must not be an obstacle to industrial investment.
fi-kk-380-2026.t: on strengthening the stock network in Eastern Finland

fi-kk-381-2026.f: Written question on the use of national flexibility for commercial forests
fi-kk-381-2026.s: The Rehabilitation Regulation is part of the European Union's efforts to halt the decline in biodiversity and improve the state of degraded ecosystems. Finnish forests are of special quality from both a natural and a national point of view.
fi-kk-381-2026.t: on the use of national flexibility for commercial forests

fi-kk-382-2026.f: Written question on the availability of Kela transport
fi-kk-382-2026.s: The new contracts will enter into force on 1 January 2027. Two service providers were selected for each of the competitive areas, and the service providers are responsible for ordering, brokering, organising and controlling the taxis.
fi-kk-382-2026.t: on the availability of Kelas transport

fi-kk-383-2026.f: Written question on the protection of traditional biotopes and natural pastures
fi-kk-383-2026.s: Traditional biotopes, i.e. fields, meadows, moors, hakasaa and forest pastures, are rich habitats shaped by traditional livestock farming, with about a quarter of all endangered species in our country, and, in terms of their surface area, they are our most abundant habitats. The traditional treatment of traditional biotopes has mainly been mowing, grazing or grazing after harvesting,
fi-kk-383-2026.t: on the safeguarding of the management of traditional biotopes and natural pastures

fi-kk-384-2026.f: Written question on working conditions, sub-contracting chains and prevention of work-related exploitation in data centre sites
fi-kk-384-2026.s: Several large-scale data centre projects are being planned and built in Finland. Data centre investments can bring significant employment impacts and potential additional investments to Finland, and especially in the construction phase, individual projects can employ a large number of employees.
fi-kk-384-2026.t: Working conditions, sub-contracting chains and prevention of work-related exploitation in data centre sites

fi-kk-385-2026.f: Written question on the safeguarding of the independence of patients and social partners and on the clarity of the patient liaison officers' activities
fi-kk-385-2026.s: The Act on Patient and Social Affairs (739/2023), which entered into force at the beginning of 2024, reorganised the organisation of the activities of patient and social affairs officer, which are responsible for organising the activities of patients and social partners in the services provided by the law.
fi-kk-385-2026.t: on the safeguarding of the independence of patients and social partners and on the clarity of the activities of patients liaison officers

fi-kk-386-2026.f: The written question of tightening the conditions for the social security of immigrants
fi-kk-386-2026.s: The Minister for Social Security, Karoliina PARTANEN (Co.), has stated in public that "the rights of immigrants to social security cannot be immediately the same as those of those who have worked here."
fi-kk-386-2026.t: tightening the social security conditions for immigrants;

fi-kk-387-2026.f: Written question on the continuity of demanding medical rehabilitation
fi-kk-387-2026.s: The families of children undergoing medical rehabilitation on the reel are concerned about future changes in the treatment services. New service provider contracts will enter into force at the beginning of 2027. Kela has allowed the continuation of existing therapies until the end of the current rehabilitation decision, but concerns arise about how to ensure continuity of the therapy relationship at the end of the rehabilitation decision.

fi-kk-388-2026.f: The written question of strengthening children's and young people's safety skills and civic skills
fi-kk-388-2026.s: The security environment has changed significantly in recent years, while the security of society, the sustainability of the crisis and the need for citizens to have security skills have increased significantly.
fi-kk-388-2026.t: Strengthening children's and young people's safety and civic skills

fi-kk-389-2026.f: Written question on the implementation of a minimum school meal time and on the consideration of food in school space planning
fi-kk-389-2026.s: School meals are a central part of the well-being of children, of learning and of the educational function of the school. According to Section 31 of the Basic Education Act, participants must be given a fully organised and guided free meal on each working day. In addition to providing meals, it is essential that the pupil has a genuine chance to eat it in peace.
fi-kk-389-2026.t: on the implementation of the minimum school dining time and the consideration of the meal in school space planning

fi-kk-390-2026.f: Written question on the adequacy of the credit compensation allowance and the safeguarding of the level of remuneration of authors of literature
fi-kk-390-2026.s: The remuneration is based on the copyright law, which provides compensation for authors for borrowing their works from libraries. It is particularly important for the livelihoods of authors and translators, and problems of adequacy have been known to the government and the Parliament of Finland for many years.
fi-kk-390-2026.t: on the adequacy of the credit compensation allocation and the safeguarding of the level of remuneration of authors of literature

fi-kk-391-2026.f: Written question on the use of the national trained carer reserve for the dismantling of waiting lists for the treatment of musculoskeletal disorders and for the strengthening of health care productivity
fi-kk-391-2026.s: The government's aim is to control the costs of social and health care, improve the productivity of public finances and ensure the ability of Finns to work and function. One of the most important sources of stress in our health care is musculoskeletal disorders (TULE). According to the Open Health Register of the Institute for Health and Welfare (THL), there are already more than 3 records of outpatient health care every year.
fi-kk-391-2026.t: on the use of the domestic qualified carer reserve for the dismantling of waiting lists for treatment of musculoskeletal disorders and for the strengthening of healthcare productivity

fi-kk-392-2026.f: Written question on the impact of changes in regional transport aid on small businesses
fi-kk-392-2026.s: Regional transport aid is intended to reduce the cost of long journeys for small and medium-sized enterprises in sparsely populated areas, to improve their competitiveness and to safeguard the conditions for business in regions with long distances to the market.
fi-kk-392-2026.t: The impact of changes in regional transport aid on small businesses

fi-kk-393-2026.f: The written question of facilitating increased fuel costs
fi-kk-393-2026.s: In the last parliamentary term, the government has taken a number of measures aimed at controlling the costs of mobility and strengthening the competitiveness of Finnish labour, enterprise and production.

fi-kk-394-2026.f: The written question of the procedures for assessing welfare areas and the correctness of funding
fi-kk-394-2026.s: In its decision of 10 September 2026, Vaasa Administrative Court annulled the decision of the Ministry of Finance to finance the South Ostrobothnia Welfare Area in 2025 and referred the matter back to the Ministry for further consideration.
fi-kk-394-2026.t: Procedures for assessing well-being areas and the correctness of funding

fi-kk-395-2026.f: Written question on delay in access to the debt facility
fi-kk-395-2026.s: The citizen has the right to have his or her case properly and without undue delay within the competent authority. Economic and debt advice is a statutory service organised by the Legal Service, one of the tasks of which is to assist the overindebted person in dealing with matters relating to the debt arrangement and in preparing the debt settlement experience and the necessary explanations.
fi-kk-395-2026.t: Delays in access to the arrangement

fi-kk-396-2026.s: A shift in employment would be welcome, but there is unfortunately a great deal to be done before anyone can be satisfied.

fi-kk-397-2026.f: Written question on the impact of VR's fleet trades on train connections
fi-kk-397-2026.s: The Board of Directors plans to finance its investment programme with, among other things, VR Group's capital repayments. According to the news released by Helsingin Sanomat on 24 September 2026, the capital repayments are based on the transfer of train equipment to a separate vehicle using debt financing.
fi-kk-397-2026.t: concerning the impact of VR's fleet trades on train connections

fi-kk-398-2026.f: Written question on the continuity of contract manufacturing of medicinal products
fi-kk-398-2026.s: In Finland, there are currently two pharmacies authorised by Fimea for the contract manufacture of medicinal products. Current contract manufacturing software supplies some of the different products.
fi-kk-398-2026.t: Continuity of contract manufacturing of medicinal products

fi-kk-399-2026.f: Written question on the impact of increased polyclinic fees on monitoring of high-risk pregnancies
fi-kk-399-2026.s: This is certainly one of the most important reasons why Finland is one of the safest countries in the world to give birth. However, the monitoring of risk pregnancies is usually carried out as pay-per-view visits. The price of monitoring for pregnant women has increased significantly during this government period.
fi-kk-399-2026.t: On the impact of increased polyclinic fees on monitoring of high-risk pregnancies

fi-kk-400-2026.f: Written question on the development of the coastline and EU funding
fi-kk-400-2026.s: The railway line is an important rail link between Helsinki and Turku and is a key part of the Southern Finland transport system. In this government period, the government has invested EUR 80 million in improving the railway line. Despite these investments, there is still a need for additional funding to ensure the condition of the railway line and to improve the flow and capacity of transport.
fi-kk-400-2026.t: The development of the coastal track and EU funding

fi-kk-401-2026.f: The written question of work-related exploitation
fi-kk-401-2026.s: Labour exploitation on construction sites does not seem to stop, quite the opposite. Data centre sites are created in Finland like mushrooms in the rain, and new projects are welcomed with open arms. The government negotiates investments with large companies at the same time as problems with working conditions and conditions can be found in data centre sites around Finland. Paavo Teittinen, in an article published in Sanomat, Helsinki, 25.9.2026

fi-kk-402-2026.f: Written question on the expiry of the period of validity of the permit
fi-kk-402-2026.s: Certain weapons are of limited duration in Finland. It is currently the responsibility of the authorisation holder to ensure that the authorisation expires and to apply for renewal of the authorisation. There is no automatic reminder system in place to inform the authorisation holder that the authorisation will expire soon.
fi-kk-402-2026.t: Remarks concerning the expiry of the authorisation

fi-kk-404-2026.s: Fuel prices have increased significantly in 2026, as a result of the crises in the Middle East and the uncertainty of the energy market, and as a result of the increase in diesel and petrol pump prices, which is particularly burdensome for commuting motorists, rural residents and the transport and logistics sector, and also reflected in the price of goods and food and the general trend towards inflation.

fi-kk-405-2026.f: Written question on State ownership control in the Soklin mining project
fi-kk-405-2026.s: On 12 February 2026, the Government decided to recapitalise the Finnish Minerals Group Oy, a wholly owned special-purpose company, with a total amount of approximately EUR 65 million to promote the Soklin mining project. The funding covers the pre-study phase of 2026-2028, during which Savukoski will be built a test-building and experimental plant.
fi-kk-405-2026.t: on State Owner's Guidance in the Soklin Mining Project

fi-kk-406-2026.f: Written question on the demarcation of zoning areas, mining districts and mining permit areas outside the scope of old state forest inventories
fi-kk-406-2026.s: Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government has committed itself to protecting the remaining national criteria for the protection of state-owned forests and old forests. The Government of Finland adopted the national criteria for old forests by a March 2025 decision, and the Finnish Forest Board has carried out an inventory of state forests based on criteria during the period 2024-2026.
fi-kk-406-2026.t: on the demarcation of areas covered by plans and of mining districts and mining permit areas outside the scope of old state forest inventories

fi-kk-407-2026.f: Written question on the implementation of the obligations of the Forest Exhaust Act in the planning area
fi-kk-407-2026.s: The formula (provincial formula, general formula and apron formula) is a legal document that should be followed. The formula may contain unclear design regulations and real restrictions on the use of forestry, and may also include a requirement for a permit to work in the landscape (except the provincial formula).
fi-kk-407-2026.t: Implementation of the obligations of the Forest Destruction Act in the planning area

fi-kk-408-2026.f: Written question on the amendment of the system of reduction of prison sentences
fi-kk-408-2026.s: Mild sentences for heavy crimes are clearly contrary to the general sense of justice. In Finland, at worst, a double discount can be obtained for imprisonment, allowing for a large reduction in the number of offences and for the provision of parole.
fi-kk-408-2026.t: amending the system of reduction of prison sentences

fi-kk-409-2026.f: Written question on the consistency of Finland's position on the EU's multiannual financial framework
fi-kk-409-2026.s: In the negotiations on the European Union's multiannual financial framework for the years 2028 to 2034, Finland has been involved in the group of Germany, Sweden, Denmark, the Netherlands and Austria, which calls for the European Commission's budget proposal to be reduced by several hundred billion euro and for resources to be allocated more strongly to defence, security, competitiveness and innovation.
fi-kk-409-2026.t: on the consistency of the position of Finland on the EU multiannual financial framework

fi-kk-410-2026.f: Written question on the safeguarding of EU funding opportunities for the East Line in the Connecting Europe Programme for the years 2028 to 2034
fi-kk-410-2026.s: On 16 July 2025, the European Commission adopted a proposal for a new regulation on the Connecting Europe Facility for the period 2028-2034 (COM (2025) 547), which will finance the development of trans-European transport and energy networks, with particular emphasis on trans-European TEN-T projects and military mobility.
fi-kk-410-2026.t: on the safeguarding of EU funding for the eastern railway line in the Connecting Europe Programme for the years 2028 to 2034

fi-kk-411-2026.f: Written question on the impact of the sale of forest berries on income support
fi-kk-411-2026.s: In Finnish forests, there is a significant annual growth of natural berries, over 90 per cent of which, according to expert estimates, are not harvested. The picking and sale of berries offer many Finns the opportunity to obtain small additional income and to participate in the sustainable exploitation of natural resources, while at the same time, berry picking contributes to health, well-being and active lifestyle.
fi-kk-411-2026.t: On the impact of sales of forest berries on income support

fi-kk-412-2026.f: Written question on the protection of companies against corporate and industrial espionage on drones
fi-kk-412-2026.s: The rapid development and spread of drones have significantly altered the safety environment. Unmanned aircraft can be used not only for legitimate purposes but also for imaging, intelligence and other unauthorised access to information.
fi-kk-412-2026.t: The protection of companies against corporate and industrial espionage on drones

fi-kk-413-2026.f: Written question on the conditions for the establishment of cryptoreserve operations in Finland
fi-kk-413-2026.s: The new EU regulation (the Mica Regulation) has created clear licensing, capital, administrative and supervisory requirements for the sector, enabling a profitable, transparent and responsible business, which is no longer an unregulated or marginal phenomenon, but a part of the European financial market.
fi-kk-413-2026.t: Conditions for the establishment of cryptoreserve operations in Finland

fi-kk-414-2026.f: Written question on speeding up projects necessary for defence and national security
fi-kk-414-2026.s: The security environment in Finland has changed fundamentally as a result of the Russian attack war against Ukraine, Finland's NATO membership and the need to rapidly strengthen Europe's defence capabilities. The changed security situation requires Finland to be able to make the necessary investments in defence, military security and national security, which are important from the point of view of defence, military security and national security.
fi-kk-414-2026.t: on speeding up projects necessary for defence and national security

fi-kk-415-2026.f: Written question on ensuring equal learning and home education for children in home education
fi-kk-415-2026.s: According to public information, there are significant shortcomings in the supervision of home education, including the lack of adequate learning or contact with other children by all homeschool learners.
fi-kk-415-2026.t: on ensuring the supervision of equal learning and home education for children in home education

fi-kk-416-2026.f: Written question on the right of a doctor to view patient information for learning purposes after the end of a treatment relationship
fi-kk-416-2026.s: High level of competence of healthcare professionals is a prerequisite for high quality care and patient safety. Professional development of a doctor is an essential part of the possibility of receiving feedback on treatment decisions, diagnoses and their consequences. By assessing the success and effectiveness of their own solutions, the doctor can develop his / her expertise.
fi-kk-416-2026.t: Doctor's right to view patient information for learning purposes after the end of the treatment relationship

fi-kk-417-2026.f: Written question on the situation of wind power in Eastern Finland
fi-kk-417-2026.s: Defence forces have limited the construction of wind turbines to the eastern border because they interfere with the investigation of the Defence Forces. This problem has been identified for a long time, and now the data centre boom in Finland makes the problem even more acute. The location of data centres in Finland requires an increasing amount of wind power to be built, so that the adequacy of electricity does not become a problem.
fi-kk-417-2026.t: From the wind power situation in Eastern Finland

fi-kk-418-2026.f: Written question on delays in payment of the loss compensation for reindeer reindeer husbandry and on the adequacy of the budget
fi-kk-418-2026.s: The Finnish reindeer business is currently living in a deep, long-term crisis. The damage caused by large predators has increased strongly in the reindeer care area, resulting in the loss of capital, live reindeer and slaughter reindeer and the financial burden borne by the boredom have risen to unsustainable levels.
fi-kk-418-2026.t: on delays in payment of compensation for losses from reindeer husbandry and on the adequacy of appropriations

fi-kk-419-2026.f: Written question on delays in updating the compensation value of land eagle damage
fi-kk-419-2026.s: The strengthening of the land eagle population and the increase in litter in reindeer husbandry areas have led to a significant increase in the damage caused by eagles to reindeer, and especially to calves, unlike major fraud, damage caused by the calmed-down land eagle is not compensated under the game damage law, but is covered by the damage caused by the calmed-down animals which entered into force in 2023.
fi-kk-419-2026.t: Delays in updating the compensation value of land eagle damage

fi-kk-420-2026.f: Written question on the financing of education and training
fi-kk-420-2026.s: The recent PISA study shows that the learning outcomes of Finnish young people have deteriorated simultaneously in mathematics, science and literacy. In Finland, changes have been stronger than the OECD average. This is fatal for Finland's future, as Finland can only succeed through knowledge.

fi-kk-421-2026.f: Written question on the impact of data centre investments on electricity adequacy in Finland
fi-kk-421-2026.s: I asked Environment Minister Multala earlier about the impact of Google's massive investment in data centre on electricity adequacy in Finland (KK 367/2026 vp). Minister Multala replied that "Google has announced that he will support new electricity generation in Finland and other investments in the electricity system. The company has contractually supported wind power capacity in Finland for a total of 629 megawatts."
fi-kk-421-2026.t: On the impact of investment in the Data Centre on electricity adequacy in Finland

fi-kk-422-2026.f: Written question on the implementation of bear quota hunting and the reasons for the related EU legal uncertainties
fi-kk-422-2026.s: In December 2025, the Parliament of Finland adopted a declaration in connection with the amendment of the hunting law that the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry should prepare, without delay, the regulations necessary to depart from the restrain of the bear and lynch by hunting under a regional quota.
fi-kk-422-2026.t: on the implementation of quota hunting for bear and the grounds for the related EU legal uncertainties

fi-kk-423-2026.f: Written question on imports of Russian nickel rock and unwrought nickel
fi-kk-423-2026.s: The EU's Russian sanctions prohibit imports of Russian copper throughout the production chain, including copper rock (CN 7401). The EU 20 and 21 sanctions package banned imports of several Russian nickel products (CN 7503-7505) and nickel and copper ores. However, nickel (CN 7501) and unwrought nickel (CN 7502) are currently excluded from the scope of the ban.
fi-kk-423-2026.t: Imports of Russian nickel rock and unwrought nickel

fi-kk-424-2026.f: Written question on closed areas for fisheries
fi-kk-424-2026.s: In Finland, the number of projects aimed at bypassing or removing hiking barriers has increased in the 2020s. In 2024, more migration barriers were passed or removed in Finland than in any other European country (Dam Removal Europe 2024).

fi-kk-425-2026.f: Written question on the vignette charge for heavy traffic
fi-kk-425-2026.s: The poor condition of the Finnish road network and the operating conditions in the transport sector are once again at the heart of the transport policy debate. The framework funds for basic road management have been cut to a record low level for the coming years.
fi-kk-425-2026.t: On the vignette charge for heavy traffic

fi-kk-426-2026.f: Written question about the mass graves in Chemann
fi-kk-426-2026.s: In the northern part of Sri Lanka, a mass tomb of Chemann in Jaffa has been dug up by mid-August 2026, and according to the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR), there are also bodies of children among the dead. Media reports that the mass grave has also found everyday items of the deceased, such as school packs and milk bottles.
fi-kk-426-2026.t: From the mass graves of Chemann

fi-kk-427-2026.f: Written question on actions against human rights and rainbow activists in Turkey
fi-kk-427-2026.s: On 12 and 13 September, Turkey witnessed a serious attack on the rainbow community and the civil society defending it. Authorities arrested rainbow activists and human rights defenders and raided the premises of 16 rainbow organisations across the country.
fi-kk-427-2026.t: on actions against human rights and rainbow activists in Turkey

fi-kk-428-2026.f: Written question on the contribution of volunteering to income security
fi-kk-428-2026.s: Volunteering is a key part of Finnish society, which strengthens inclusion and communitarianism, as well as complements public services in a wide range of ways, including social and health organisations, older people and youth work, cultural and event activities, sports and sports clubs, crisis work and business twinning.
fi-kk-428-2026.t: The impact of voluntary work on income security

fi-kk-429-2026.f: Written question on the further preparation of the Tampere-Turku train connection
fi-kk-429-2026.s: The development of the Tampere-Turku-Naantalrailway link as part of the ongoing passenger train tendering process has already been blocked before its challenges and opportunities have been openly assessed.
fi-kk-429-2026.t: Making Tampere-Turku train connection ready for further preparation

fi-kk-430-2026.f: The written question of extending the period of parental leave to seven years after the birth of the child
fi-kk-430-2026.s: The reform of family leave entered into force in August 2022. Many things changed for the better: the number of fathers' family leave increased, the use of parental leave became more flexible, the reconciliation of family life and work was facilitated, and the whole system was simplified.
fi-kk-430-2026.t: extending the period of parental benefit to seven years from the birth of the child

fi-kk-431-2026.f: Written question on links between wolf quota hunting, wild boar stock and African swine fever
fi-kk-431-2026.s: In winter 2026, a quota hunt for a wolf, defined as threatened in Finland, was carried out in the South East-Finland area, where wolves were also killed. Based on DNA analyses by the Natural Resources Centre, the South West-Finland quota area also identified dog wolves, whose removal has been considered important in maintaining the genetic purity of the wolf population.
fi-kk-431-2026.t: on the links between wolf quota hunting, wild boar stock and African swine fever

fi-kk-432-2026.f: Written question on the development of polytechnic education for clinics
fi-kk-432-2026.s: The skills and responsibilities of clinics have increased as a result of the rapid development of veterinary, therapeutic and technological processes. However, the current education system does not fully meet the changed skills needs of the industry. In Finland, the training of clinician nurses is based mainly on vocational qualifications and there is no own polytechnic degree in the field.
fi-kk-432-2026.t: Development of polytechnic education for clinics

fi-kk-433-2026.f: Written question on the status of drug cannabis and the exercise of patients' rights
fi-kk-433-2026.s: Many Finns do not get the herbal medicine they need because they require special permission, and getting a prescription is more difficult.
fi-kk-433-2026.t: The role of medical cannabis and the realisation of patients' rights

fi-kk-434-2026.f: Written question on strengthening the needs-based nature of the therapy programme
fi-kk-434-2026.s: The therapy guarantee is based on the citizens' initiative KAA 10/2019, submitted to the Parliament of Finland in 2019, which received over 50 000 statements of support. The aim of the draft law was to ensure rapid access for all to therapeutic psychotherapy or other psychosocial care after the first visit to the health centre.
fi-kk-434-2026.t: Strengthening the needs-based nature of therapy ataxia

fi-kk-436-2026.f: The written question of making the cost of voluntary tick vaccination tax deductible
fi-kk-436-2026.s: TBE is a tick-brain disease that has been transmitted by ticks and has increased number of cases in Finland in the long term. The disease can be prevented by vaccination. The so-called tick vaccine protects against tick-brain infection, but not from borreliosis or tick bites.
fi-kk-436-2026.t: setting the cost of voluntary tick vaccination as tax deductible

fi-kk-437-2026.f: Written question on the control of the impediments of public authorities and the realisation of legal certainty in prolonged judicial and enforcement processes
fi-kk-437-2026.s: section 21 of the Finnish Constitution provides everyone with the right to be properly and without undue delay, and the right to be heard, to have a reasoned decision and to appeal. section 22 of the Constitution obliges the public authorities to ensure the fulfilment of fundamental and human rights. fi-kk-438-2026.f: The written question of reducing the administrative burden on banking services of small associations
fi-kk-438-2026.s: Small village associations, leisure associations and other non-profit organisations are doing valuable work to promote local community, leisure opportunities and the well-being of people, which are largely based on voluntary work, and the annual financial flows of many associations are only a few hundred or thousands of euros.
fi-kk-438-2026.t: on reducing the administrative burden on banking services of small associations

fi-kk-440-2026.f: Written question on the placement of icebreakers in northern Finland
fi-kk-440-2026.s: The changed safety environment in Finland has highlighted the importance of security of supply, logistics capacity and critical infrastructure for national security. A significant part of Finnish industrial exports pass through the ports of northern Finland, which makes the ports of the Bothnian Sea region essential, especially for the forestry, steel, mining and energy sectors, both in everyday life and in the exceptional situation.
fi-kk-440-2026.t: from the installation of icebreakers in northern Finland

fi-kk-441-2026.f: The written question of rising energy prices and safeguarding public transport conditions
fi-kk-441-2026.s: Higher energy prices have recently increased cost pressures for households, agriculture and industry. The uncertainty of the international environment and the impact of the situation in the Middle East on the energy markets underline the need to assess ways to mitigate the effects of energy price volatility in Finland.
fi-kk-441-2026.t: Energy price increases and public transport conditions

fi-la-29-2026.f: Legislative initiative amending section 13 of the Consumer Protection Act, the Digital and Population Information Agency Act on certain personal registers and the Consumer Protection Authority Act on certain competences
fi-la-29-2026.s: This legislative initiative proposes to strengthen consumer protection, particularly in situations where the consumer is more vulnerable to aggressive or oppressive marketing and sales due to ageing, reduced capacity to act, reduced health status or other personal circumstances.
fi-la-29-2026.t: As regards the law on certain personal registers of the Consumer Protection Act, the Digital and Population Information Agency, and on certain powers of the consumer protection authorities,

fi-la-30-2026.f: Act amending section 24 of the Welfare Act
fi-la-30-2026.s: The aim of the initiative is to reduce the number of persons authorised in welfare areas by their own decision below the current minimum. The number of persons authorised in welfare areas is laid down in Article 24 of the Welfare Code. The minimum number of persons authorised in the territory of 200 000 inhabitants is 59, in the area of 200 001 to 400 000, 69 delegates in the region of 400 001 to 600 000.
fi-la-30-2026.t: Amendment of section 24 of the Welfare Act

fi-la-31-2026.f: Legislative initiative amending section 2 of the Social and Health Care Control Act and the Patient Insurance Act
fi-la-31-2026.s: The bill introduces provisions on health-related cosmetic services to be included in the law on social and healthcare supervision, which would cover cosmetic measures, injections and treatments without medical or dental justification which, if failed, could cause a serious injury, illness, complication or
fi-la-31-2026.t: As a law amending section 2 of the Act on the Supervision of Social and Health Care and of the Patient Insurance Act

fi-la-32-2026.f: Legislative initiative amending Annex 1 to the Act on the Environmental Impact Assessment
fi-la-32-2026.s: The initiative proposes to amend the Environmental Impact Assessment Act by adding large data centres to the list of projects in Annex 1 to the Act.
fi-la-32-2026.t: amending Annex 1 to the Law on the Environmental Impact Assessment

fi-la-33-2026.f: Legislative initiative amending section 11 of the Act on the candidate's financing of elections
fi-la-33-2026.s: The initiative amends section 11 of the Act on candidate funding (273/2009), making prior notification of election funding compulsory for all candidates required to report.
fi-la-33-2026.t: Act amending section 11 of the Act on the candidate's electoral funding

fi-la-34-2026.s: The initiative proposes that the Mining Act (621/2011) be more precise, ensuring an adequate level of environmental protection in extractive activities in order to preserve biodiversity and not to the detriment of biodiversity and its national and international objectives.

fi-la-35-2026.f: Legislative initiative to amend the Act on the organisation of the markets in agricultural products
fi-la-35-2026.s: The legislative initiative proposes to amend the Law on the organisation of the markets in agricultural products so that the Food Agency could also accept, on application, the association of producer organisations within the meaning of Article 156 of the Regulation on the organisation of the market in the European Union.
fi-la-35-2026.t: Act amending the Act on the organisation of the markets in agricultural products

fi-la-36-2026.f: Legislative initiative amending section 53 of the Health Act, sections 25a and 45 of the Social Welfare Act and section 10a of the Law on Higher Education.
fi-la-36-2026.s: Mental health disorders are one of the biggest public health and economic challenges in Finland. At some point in life, one in two Finns experiences a mental disorder, but only about half of those with a condition receive the treatment they need. The cost of mental health disorders alone to Finland is over EUR 11 billion per year. Access to treatment is slow in many places, and ho
fi-la-36-2026.t: Act amending section 53 (a) of the Health Act, sections 25a and 45 of the Social Welfare Act and section 10a of the Law on Higher Education

fi-la-37-2026.f: Legislative initiative amending section 5 of the Act on social and health care charges
fi-la-37-2026.s: On 21 September 2026, the Board of Directors submitted to the Parliament of Finland a proposal HE 185/2026 vp setting a new operating fee for health care from 1 March 2027. The fee would be up to EUR 264,10, or 10% higher than the current daily surgery fee (EUR 233,80). Prior to the increases in customer fees during this government period, the customer fee for day surgery was EUR 136,90.
fi-la-37-2026.t: Act amending section 5 of the Act on social and health care charges

fi-toim-fiva-40-2026.s: The need for amendments to the provisions and instructions related to the EU Capital Requirements Regulation (CRR3) and Guideline (EU) 2025 / 152 of the European Parliament and of the Council) 1 have arisen, in particular, from changes in the EU Capital Requirements Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2024/1623 of the European Parliament and of the Council) and the ECB Guideline (EU) 2025 / 152.
fi-toim-fiva-40-2026.t: Amendments to the provisions and guidelines relating to the EU Capital Requirements Regulation 5/2019

fi-toim-fiva-41-2026.s: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has published a final report on EBA / GL / 2026 / 05 on 7 May 2026 on guidelines for amending the Guidelines on the application of the definition of "default 'in accordance with Article 178 of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013. The guidelines amend the previous EBA Guideline EBA / GL / 2016 / 07. The financial supervision has announced its intention to follow the amended guideline.
fi-toim-fiva-41-2026.t: The Commission shall, by means of implementing acts, adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 290 concerning the conditions for the application of this Regulation, in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in paragraph 1.

fi-toim-fiva-44-2026.s: The European Banking Authority (EBA) has issued updated product management guidelines for retail banking products (EBA / GL / 2015 / 18) published by EBA / GL / 2026 / 07 on 30 June 2026. The updated guidelines specify environmental, social responsibility and good governance (ESG) requirements when products with such features are offered and sold to consumers, and address the risks related to green washing.
fi-toim-fiva-44-2026.t: The change to the EBA guidance on the product management procedure for retail banking products will start on 11 January 2027.

fi-toim-fiva-45-2026.s: The Financial Supervisory Authority has published on its website the principles it takes into account in its overall assessment of the scope of the penalty and penalty payments, which have been more precise in practice than previously published principles. These changes reflect established practices. The main clarification of the principles published in 2022 concerns the co-operation of the author with the Financial Supervisory Authority in order to clarify the matter.
fi-toim-fiva-45-2026.t: Principles for measuring penalty and penalty payments updated

fi-toim-fiva-49-2026.s: The Financial Supervisory Authority has updated the provisions and guidelines on the registration of certain creditors and peer credit intermediaries 3/2023, which are mainly based on certain amendments to the Law on Lending and Peer Credit Intermediaries 1 and enter into force simultaneously with the legislative amendments of 20 November 2026.
fi-toim-fiva-49-2026.t: Amendments to the provisions and guidelines for the registration of certain creditors and peers 3/2023

fi-toim-fiva-52-2026.s: The Financial Supervisory Authority has amended the provisions and guidelines 1/2011, 13/2012, 14/2012, 15/2012, 4/2015, 9/2016, 2/2017, 10/2017, 8/2018, 1/2019 and 11/2021. At the same time, the participation of insurance corporations in the construction activities under the Housing Act has been repealed. The amendments will mainly enter into force on 1.1.2027. The majority of the amendments concern occupational pension insurance. The withdrawal of the statement 5/2011 also applies to insurance funds, non-life insurance companies and insurance associations.
fi-toim-fiva-52-2026.t: Amendments to the regulations and guidelines in the field of occupational pensions, and to the provisions and guidelines of non-life and non-life insurance

A reference to the definition of income from Finland for family pensions (Chapter 4.2.4) and the elimination of double taxation when the United States taxes a US citizen resident in Finland on grounds of nationality, although the tax agreement would not otherwise give the United States the right to tax (Chapter 5...).
